title: Production Manager
description:
**Company Description**
KSI – Krishna Steel Industries specializes in cold drawn steel wires ranging from 4 mm to 12 mm, designed for a wide variety of engineering applications. The wires offer superior surface finish and tight dimensional tolerances, making them suitable for machining with automatic systems, including 2D and 3D bending. Key applications include fastener manufacturing, chrome plating, galvanizing, and other precision engineering uses. Products are supplied in spooled coil form and cut-to-length bar form, supporting higher productivity and reduced machining losses. KSI provides a broad range of dimensional tolerances and finishes to meet diverse customer requirements and performance standards.
  
**Role Description**
The Production Manager role at KSI – Krishna Steel Industries is a full-time hybrid position, based in Ahmedabad with some flexibility for work-from-home tasks. The Production Manager oversees daily manufacturing operations, including planning and scheduling production, monitoring output, and ensuring that cold drawn wire and bar products meet quality and tolerance specifications. This role coordinates with procurement, maintenance, and quality teams to ensure continuous production flow, optimal resource utilization, and adherence to safety and compliance standards. The Production Manager analyzes production data, identifies process improvements, and implements corrective actions to increase efficiency and reduce waste. The role also involves supervising and mentoring production staff, managing shift performance, and communicating with management and customers on delivery timelines and technical requirements.
  
**Qualifications**

* Strong production management skills, including planning, scheduling, and coordinating manufacturing activities in a steel or metal-processing environment.
* Experience with process optimization, lean manufacturing, or continuous improvement methodologies to enhance productivity and reduce losses.
* Knowledge of quality control, dimensional tolerances, and surface finishing processes relevant to cold drawn wires and bars.
* Ability to interpret technical drawings, engineering specifications, and customer requirements for wire and bar applications.
* Proficiency in using production management software, basic ERP tools, and standard office applications for reporting and data analysis.
* Strong leadership skills, including team supervision, performance management, and effective communication across departments.
* Understanding of workplace safety standards and regulatory compliance within industrial manufacturing settings.
* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Mechanical Engineering, Metallurgy, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical field; relevant experience in steel or engineering products manufacturing is highly beneficial.
* Ability to work effectively in a hybrid arrangement, managing on-site operations in Ahmedabad while handling planning and reporting tasks remotely when needed.

* Prepare technical specifications, requisitions, and evaluate vendor/OEM proposals.
* Support preparation of CapEx and OpEx estimates for automation and instrumentation systems.

**Automation & Control Systems**

* Review PLC, SCADA, HMI, and automation software programs, logic, functionality, and system architecture.
* Ensure seamless integration of instrumentation, automation, and monitoring systems.
* Participate in technology improvements, automation initiatives, and digital transformation projects.
* Ensure compliance with applicable engineering standards, codes, and industry best practices.

**Testing & Commissioning**

* Lead Testing & Commissioning (T&C) activities for:
* District Cooling Plants (DCP)
* Energy Transfer Stations (ETS)
* Thermal Energy Storage (TES)
* Chilled Water Distribution Networks
* Conduct inspections and performance validation of field instrumentation and control systems.
* Support troubleshooting, optimization, and operational readiness activities.

**Communication Networks & Systems**

* Manage industrial communication networks including:
* Modbus
* Profibus
* OPC
* Industrial Ethernet
* Review and support Fiber Optic network installations and integration.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Coordinate with project teams, engineering disciplines, consultants, contractors, OEMs, and service providers.
* Provide technical support to project execution and operations teams.
* Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to ensure successful project delivery.

**Desired Candidate Profile**

**Education**

* Bachelor's Degree in Instrumentation Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Automation Engineering, or related discipline.

**Experience**

* 8-12+ years of experience in Instrumentation & Control Engineering.
* Hands-on experience in PLC, SCADA, HMI, and industrial automation systems.
* Experience in testing, commissioning, and troubleshooting of industrial control systems.
* Experience in District Cooling, HVAC, Utility Plants, Chiller Plants, Industrial Utilities, Water Infrastructure, or Process Plants preferred.
* Experience with medium to large District Cooling Plants and HVAC control systems will be an added advantage.

**Technical Skills**

* PLC & SCADA Systems
* HMI Development & Configuration
* Instrumentation Engineering
* Control System Architecture
* Industrial Automation
* Process Control Systems
* Fiber Optic Networks
* Modbus, Profibus, OPC
* Industrial Ethernet Networks
* HVAC & Utility Plant Controls
* P&ID Interpretation
* Testing & Commissioning

**Key Competencies**

* Problem Solving & Analytical Thinking
* Project Coordination
* Stakeholder Management
* Vendor & OEM Management
* Communication & Collaboration
* Attention to Detail
* Safety & Compliance Focus

**Why Join Us?**

* Opportunity to work on large-scale District Cooling infrastructure projects.
* Exposure to advanced automation, digitalization, and smart utility systems.
* Collaborate with industry-leading engineering and project teams.
* Contribute to sustainable and energy-efficient cooling solutions.

title: QA/QC ENGINEER - ELECTRONICS
description:
**ABOUT US:**

Join a team that is redefining the accessibility of space. Azista space is a transformative force in the global aerospace sector, uniquely positioned at the intersection of indigenous innovation and industrial scalability. Operating India’s first private-sector satellite mass-production facility in Ahmedabad, we have bridged the gap between complex engineering and high-volume manufacturing.

As a vertically integrated leader, we provide end-to-end solutions from the precision design of satellite buses and advanced payloads to mission management and communication systems. We don’t just build hardware, we are democratizing the final frontier by providing global clientele with the cost-effective, high-performance technology needed to power the next generation of orbital missions. At Azista, you won't just be starting a job, you’ll be fuelling the future of space exploration.

**JOB SUMMARY:**

We are looking for a passionate
**QA/QC Engineer – Electronics**
to drive engineering excellence and maintain uncompromising quality standards across the entire satellite lifecycle. In this role, you will collaborate closely with Design, Production, and Assembly, Integration, and Testing (AIT) teams, owning quality assurance, reliability analysis, and compliance protocols for advanced satellite electronics and hardware.

You will own the verification of space-grade components, lead root cause analyses, and ensure our systems perform reliably in the harshest orbital environments. If you are driven by precision, technical rigor, and the thrill of space exploration, this is your opportunity to put your stamp on history.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* **Quality Assurance Leadership:**
  Develop and implement robust QA plans, procedures, and inspection standards aligned with ECSS, ISRO-PAS, MIL-STD, and industry best practices.
* **Design Phase Integration:**
  Partner with cross-functional teams during System Requirements Review (SRR), Preliminary Design Review (PDR), and Critical Design Review (CDR) to bake quality into every phase of design.
* **Reliability & Circuit Analysis:**
  Perform network analysis, derating analysis, worst-case analysis, FMEA, FMECA, Fault Tree Analysis (FTA), and Reliability Block Diagram (RBD) studies to identify and mitigate design vulnerabilities.
* **AIT & Environmental Compliance:**
  Review and validate environmental qualification test results—including Thermal, Vibration, EMI/EMC, and Thermal Vacuum (TVAC) testing—and verify compliance with Acceptance Test Procedures (ATP).
* **Audit & Configuration Control:**
  Conduct internal and supplier quality audits while maintaining end-to-end component traceability, configuration management, and documentation control.
* **Non-Conformance Management:**
  Investigate non-conformances, perform root cause analysis (RCA), implement Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA), and drive continuous quality improvement across electronic manufacturing.

**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR?**

* **Education:**
  Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics & Communication Engineering (ECE), or equivalent.
* **Experience:**
  2+ years of hands-on Quality Assurance (QA/QC) experience within Aerospace, Space, Satellite, Defence, Electronics Manufacturing, or High-Reliability Systems.
* **Standards & Compliance:**
  Strong knowledge of ECSS, ISRO-PAS, MIL-STD-883, IPC-A-610, and quality management principles.
* **Technical Expertise:**
  Practical background in supporting satellite electronics, avionics, power electronics, on-board computers, RF systems, or payloads, alongside circuit derating and worst-case analysis skills.
* **Methodologies:**
  Familiarity with FMEA, FMECA, FTA, RCA, CAPA, and reliability engineering frameworks.
* **Core Competencies:**
  Exceptional analytical thinking, rigorous documentation discipline, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

**NICE-TO-HAVE SKILLS & EXPERIENCE**

* Hands-on experience in Satellite Assembly, Integration & Testing (AIT) quality processes.
* Familiarity with cleanroom operations, contamination control, and ESD-safe handling practices.
* Experience with satellite subsystems such as Reaction Wheels, Battery Systems, EPS, CDH, PCU, and RF Payloads.
* Certifications or working knowledge of AS9100, ISO 9001, or Six Sigma (Green/Black Belt).

**WHY JOIN US?**

* **Pioneering Impact:**
  Work at the vanguard of India's private space revolution, contributing directly to hardware that reaches orbit.
* **End-to-End Exposure:**
  Gain comprehensive visibility across the entire satellite lifecycle, from initial design reviews to final environmental testing and launch readiness.
* **Innovation Culture:**
  Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams of brilliant aerospace engineers in a fast-paced, high-growth, mission-driven environment.
* **Career Growth:**
  Scale your expertise alongside state-of-the-art satellite mass-production infrastructure and global projects.

title: Traffic Manager
description:
Traffic Manager – By Road Department

**Company:**
Shree Shipping Services Private Limited (SSSPL)

**Department:**
Road Transportation / Traffic

**Proposed Salary:**
₹18,000–₹20,000 per month

**Incentive:**
Additional performance-based incentives for new customer acquisition

**Reporting To:**
By Road Business Head / Operations Head

**Location:**
As per business requirement

1. Job Objective

To manage daily road transportation operations, maintain an updated vehicle and customer tracker, coordinate with transporters and customers, ensure timely execution of consignments, and actively acquire new customers to generate additional business for the By Road Department.

The role combines
**operational tracking, customer coordination, business development, and revenue generation**
.

2. Key Responsibilities

**A. Traffic Management & Tracking**

* Maintain and update the daily traffic tracker covering all consignments, including vehicle placement, reporting, loading, dispatch, transit status, delivery, and Proof of Delivery (POD).
* Coordinate with transporters, vehicle owners, drivers, and customers to ensure timely vehicle placement and delivery.
* Track vehicle movement and proactively identify delays, route deviations, breakdowns, and other operational issues.
* Maintain records of freight rates, vehicle availability, transporter details, customer requirements, and pending consignments.
* Follow up for PODs, delivery confirmations, and closure of completed consignments.
* Prepare daily MIS reports highlighting pending vehicles, delayed deliveries, completed trips, and exceptions.
* Ensure accurate documentation and timely updating of all operational data.

**B. New Customer Acquisition & Business Development**

* Identify and approach potential customers requiring road transportation, FTL, PTL, and other applicable logistics services.
* Generate leads through telephone calls, email, referrals, online research, and market mapping.
* Contact manufacturers, traders, distributors, exporters, and other businesses with road transportation requirements.
* Understand customer requirements, collect shipment details, and coordinate internally to provide competitive freight quotations.
* Follow up on quotations and convert qualified leads into active customers.
* Maintain a customer acquisition tracker covering leads generated, calls made, quotations submitted, follow-ups, and confirmed business.
* Develop and maintain relationships with new customers to generate repeat business.
* Coordinate with the operations team to ensure smooth execution of newly acquired business.

**C. Customer & Transporter Coordination**

* Act as a coordination point between customers, transporters, drivers, and internal operations teams.
* Provide timely shipment updates and resolve routine customer queries.
* Support freight negotiation and vehicle sourcing in coordination with the reporting manager.
* Escalate service issues, delivery delays, and customer complaints promptly.
* Maintain professional communication and build long-term business relationships.

**D. Reporting & Documentation**

* Submit daily traffic and customer acquisition reports.
* Maintain accurate customer, transporter, lead, quotation, and shipment databases.
* Track outstanding PODs and pending operational documentation.
* Support the preparation of monthly performance reports covering operational efficiency and new business generated.

3. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

KPIProposed TargetTraffic tracker accuracy98% or aboveDaily tracker updates100% of active consignmentsShipment status reportingTimely updates as per company processPOD follow-up100% of delivered consignments trackedNew qualified leads40–60 per monthCustomer outreach15–20 calls per working dayQuotations generatedMinimum 10–15 per month, subject to lead qualityNew customers acquired2–3 active customers per monthRepeat businessTrack and develop recurring business from acquired customersCustomer serviceTimely response and escalation of issues

*The targets above are proposed starting benchmarks and may be revised based on business volume, lead quality, and market conditions.*

4. Salary & Incentive Structure

**Fixed Salary:**
₹18,000–₹20,000 per month.

**Additional Incentive:**
Performance-linked incentive for new customer acquisition and business generation, over and above the fixed salary.

5. Qualifications & Experience

* Graduate in any discipline; candidates with logistics or supply chain qualifications preferred.
* Approximately 1–3 years of experience in road transportation, freight forwarding, traffic operations, logistics coordination, or sales support.
* Freshers with strong communication and business development skills may also be considered.
* Basic knowledge of road freight, FTL/PTL, transporter coordination, and shipment documentation is desirable.
* Working knowledge of MS Excel, email, and online tracking tools.

6. Required Skills

* Strong follow-up and coordination skills.
* Good telephone communication and customer handling.
* Ability to maintain accurate trackers and prepare MIS reports.
* Customer acquisition, lead generation, and negotiation skills.
* Problem-solving ability and attention to detail.
* Target-oriented approach with a focus on operational discipline and revenue generation.

7. Expected Outcomes

Within the first 90 days, the candidate should be able to:

* Independently maintain the daily traffic tracker and provide accurate shipment visibility.
* Establish a structured database of prospective road transport customers.
* Generate a consistent pipeline of qualified leads and quotations.
* Convert initial prospects into paying customers.
* Demonstrate measurable contribution to new business generation while maintaining operational accuracy.

8. Ideal Candidate Profile

A proactive and commercially minded logistics professional who can efficiently manage daily road traffic operations while actively identifying and converting new business opportunities. The candidate must demonstrate strong follow-up discipline, ownership, customer service orientation, and a clear focus on generating profitable business for SSSPL.

title: Asset Infra Head - Airport Projects
description:
**Responsibilities**
About Business:
  
  
**Adani Group**
: Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large scale infrastructure development in India with O & M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.
  
  
**Adani Airports Holding Limited**
: Adani Airports Holding Limited is reshaping the aviation landscape, transforming airports into dynamic hubs of connectivity, innovation, and service excellence. By prioritizing passenger experience, leveraging state-of-the-art technology, and enhancing operational efficiency, we are redefining airport infrastructure across India. Our vision is to create world-class airports that serve as gateways to regional development and global connectivity, positioning Adani Airports as a leader in the aviation sector with a focus on sustainable growth and community impact.
  
  
**Job Purpose:**
Head - Project is responsible for overseeing the successful execution of all airside, terminal and landside projects. This role involves leading cross-functional project teams, ensuring compliance with project budgets, timelines, and quality standards, and delivering projects that align with the strategic goals of the airport's master plan. The role requires a strong focus on project management, stakeholder coordination, risk management, sustainability, and regulatory compliance.
  
  

* Key Responsibilities of Role

**Site Delivery & Front Management**

* Own delivery of the site against the baseline — cost, schedule, quality and safety — and the recovery plan when it slips.
* Integrate civil, mechanical, electrical, commissioning and enabling works into one sequenced, de-conflicted front.
* Keep work fronts open and productive — sequence fronts, balance resources and break the daily bottlenecks that stall progress.

**Drive contractor performance and productivity;**

* hold them to programmed, manpower and method commitments.

**Safety, Quality & Statutory Ownership On The Ground**

* Be visibly, personally accountable for zero harm — set the tone, walk the site, and back every stop-work made for the right reason.
* Own built quality — ensure hold-points, inspections and build-right-first-time discipline are real, not paperwork.
* Ensure statutory, environmental and labor compliance is live on site — permits, consents, hold-points and conditions are met before and during work.
* Make sure execution never runs ahead of land, ROW and statutory clearance for a given front.

**Cost, Commercial & Resource Control**

* Own site cost and productivity — manpower, plant, material and cash deployed for output, not just activity.
* Govern measurement, billing and certification with the Project Controller so paid work equals built work.
* Control change at source — flag scope creep and field changes early, with cost and time impact, before they become claims.
* Optimize the deployment of shared resources across contractors and fronts.

**Stakeholder, Land & Community Peace**

* Hold day-to-day peace with the local community, land owners, labor and local administration — the relationships that keep fronts open.
* Own escalation and resolution of land, ROW, R&R and statutory blockers that threaten the front, working HO and authorities together.
* Steward CSR, environment, horticulture and local-employment commitments as the project's license to operate.
* Be the project's credible local face when an issue could escalate beyond the gate. Site Organization, Risk & Readiness
* Build and lead an integrated site team across functions and contractors; set clear ownership and a fast escalation path.
* Run a disciplined site governance rhythm — daily fronts, weekly progress, risk and look-ahead — that surfaces problems early.
* Own the top site risks and their mitigation; ensure no single failure can quietly stop the project.
* Drive readiness for testing, commissioning and handover from early in execution, not as an afterthought.
* Deliver site pre-con readiness against the zero-date model - secured land, statutory permissions, pre-con studies, site and staff infrastructure, worker infrastructure and logistics.
* Engage GC partners early for constructability and value-engineering and hold the proposed project start date so actual start matches plan.
* Run execution through the PMC-led alliance model with defined scope and role clarity across owner, PMC and GC, and confirm PMC mobilization and manpower deployment to plan.
* Conduct site project reviews on the Parivartan cost and schedule dashboards.
* Complete and sign off the project closure report for completed site projects.
* Uphold labor-law compliance with timely third-party audits, standardized worker accommodation, colony and central kitchen, effective grievance redressal, and end-to-end workmen lifecycle monitoring.

**Decision Authority & Accountability**

* Final site authority on day-to-day execution, sequencing and resource deployment.
* Sole authority to stop work on safety, quality, statutory or labor-risk grounds, and to back others who do.
* Approves site-level spend, work-front release and contractor instructions within the Delegation of Authority.
* Authority to redeploy site resources across contractors and fronts to protect the critical path.
* Accountable to the CPO for site cost and schedule outturn, statutory compliance, zero fatality and front availability.

**Internal Interactions CPO;**
HO Function Heads (Pre-Construction, Engineering, CFMC, PMO, CAD, Safety, Quality); all Site Leads (Civil / Mechanical / Electrical / Commissioning / Environment / Safety / Security etc.); Project Controller; Capex TC; Project HR & Admin; Stores
  
  
**External Interactions**
Contractors & PMC; District / local administration & police; Statutory, environmental & labor authorities; Land owners & community / R&R representatives; Utilities & service providers; Lender's / owner's engineers (site visits)
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Qualification:**
Bachelor's in Civil / Mechanical / Electrical Engineering;
  
  
MBA / Construction or Project Management preferred
  
  
**Experience**
18+ years in site execution of large infrastructure / EPC projects, including 6+ years as Site / Project Manager owning a full project front

title: Senior Manager, Platform Software Engineering
description:
**Job Description**
Team owns the layer between clients and backend workloads: proxy and L7 services, API Gateway, and inference gateway for AI traffic. Every request to backend services passes through this layer, so latency, availability, and correctness here directly affect everything downstream. You'll build and grow the team, set its technical direction, and own these services end to end, from design through production operations.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Problems the team works on:**

* Proxy and L7: request routing, TLS termination, connection management, config propagation across a large fleet, and keeping tail latency predictable under load.
* API Gateway: authentication and authorization, rate limiting and quotas, traffic policies, and giving service teams a safe, self-serve way to expose APIs.
* Inference gateway: routing AI inference traffic, which behaves differently from typical web traffic. Requests are long-running and often streamed, cost varies widely by request, and backend GPU capacity is expensive and limited. That makes routing, queuing, fairness, and capacity efficiency hard problems.

**What you'll do:**

* Build and grow the team: hire engineers and tech leads, set expectations, give direct feedback, and develop people over time.
* Define the team's roadmap and priorities with leadership and partner teams.
* Stay close enough to the technical work to review designs, weigh tradeoffs, and make calls when needed.
* Own the operational health of the services: on-call, incident response, postmortems, and follow-through on reliability work.
* Work closely with networking, security, platform, and ML infrastructure teams on problems that cross team boundaries.

**What we're looking for:**

* Experience managing engineers who build and operate distributed systems in production.
* A solid technical background in at least one of: proxies and load balancing, API gateways, service mesh, networking, or high-throughput backend services.
* Experience running latency-sensitive services, including on-call and incident management.
* Experience building something new, such as starting a team, launching a new service, or taking a product from early design to production.
* A track record of hiring well and helping engineers grow.

**Nice to have:**

* Hands-on experience with Envoy, NGINX or similar.
* Familiarity with LLM inference serving (batching, streaming, GPU utilization).
* Experience building internal platforms used by many engineering teams.

**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. The position requires strong leadership, technical expertise and a focus on achieving operational excellence while ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and fostering a safe and productive work environment.

The position would report directly to the Managing Director of India.

**Min 12 to 20 Years of experience in Textile, Chemical, Cement and Paper Industry or a relevant manufacturing setup.**

1. Broadly 5-6 plant functions will report into the plant head (Production, Operations, Maintenance, Stores, Purchase, Utilities, Support Functions)
2. Operations Management: Overseeing day-to-day operations of the plant, including production, maintenance, quality control, and logistics. Optimizing processes to maximize efficiency and reduce costs while maintaining product quality.
3. Regulatory Compliance: Ensuring adherence to all local laws, regulations, and permits related to the manufacturing operations.
4. Team Leadership: Leading and motivating a diverse team of employees, including supervisors, engineers, technicians, operators and workers.

6. Resource Allocation: Managing resources such as manpower, equipment, and materials effectively.
7. Health, Safety, and Environment Compliance: Ensuring compliance with health, safety and environmental regulations and standards.
8. Stakeholder Management: Collaborating with internal stakeholders (such as senior management, other departments) to meet company goals. Building and maintaining relationships with externalstakeholders, including suppliers and service providers.
9. Financial Management: Managing the plant's budget and expenditures effectively.
10. Crisis Management: Addressing any emergencies or unexpected situations that may impact plant operations promptly and effectively.

**Desired Candidate**

1. Ideal Candidate – 12 to 20 Years of experience in a relevant manufacturing setup (not necessarily from competition organisation). At present the candidate who is a senior Operations/Productions role in a comparable organisation scale will be an ideal fit for the role.

title: Associate Technical Program Manager
description:
**Associate Technical Program Manager**

Ahmedabad, Gujarat | Full-time, On-site | Monday to Saturday

Experience: 1-5 years | Reports to: Founder & CEO | Joining: Immediate or early joining preferred

**ABOUT SVECTOR**

SVECTOR builds enterprise software and decision-intelligence systems for complex industries and high-stakes business environments. Our work spans enterprise AI, healthcare, industrial intelligence, talent intelligence and financial intelligence.

Engineering, product, research, customer requirements and business execution are closely connected here, and this role sits at the center of that.

READ THIS BEFORE YOU APPLY

This role combines Technical Program Management with Chief of Staff responsibilities, working directly with the Founder & CEO. It is designed for early-career professionals with 1-5 years of experience who want heavy responsibility early. It is not a senior or leadership position, and we will not consider applicants with significantly more experience than this range. It is a six-day, on-site role in Ahmedabad, not remote or hybrid. It is not an admin, calendar or task-tracking job, and "I passed it on" does not count as finished work. If you are ready to earn responsibility through real work, read on.

THE ROLE

You will work directly with the Founder & CEO on important product, technology, customer and business initiatives, and with engineering, product and business teams to get them done. On one initiative you may be working with engineers to resolve an API integration. On another you may be preparing a customer requirements brief, evaluating an unfamiliar technology, coordinating a product demo or driving a business priority to completion.

The job in one line: understand the problem, decide what needs to happen, bring the right people and information together, and make sure the intended result is delivered and verified.

You do not need prior experience with these titles. You do need technical curiosity, strong analytical ability, reliable execution and the willingness to own difficult work. We do not want someone who only tracks tasks, schedules meetings or forwards instructions. We want someone who understands the substance and owns the outcome.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Technical Program Execution

- Turn broad priorities into clear workstreams with owners, milestones, dependencies and acceptance criteria

- Coordinate engineers, product contributors and business stakeholders

- Track real progress, not just reported task status

- Investigate blockers and find out why work is delayed or incomplete

- Raise risks before deadlines are missed and propose practical recovery plans

- Verify that delivered work meets the original requirement

A task marked done is not a completed program. The outcome has to be verified.

Product and Software Understanding

- Understand user journeys and product workflows, and test our software

- Write PRDs, BRDs, functional requirements and acceptance criteria

- Read API documentation, JSON structures and integration specifications

- Understand authentication, data flows and external service dependencies

- Reproduce issues and document expected versus actual behaviour

- Convert customer feedback into actionable requirements

- Support demos, pilots and implementation work

You are not expected to replace an engineer or decide architecture. You are expected to understand the technology well enough to ask meaningful questions and spot missing information. Blind coordination is not enough.

Ownership and Accountability

For every assignment, establish the problem, the expected outcome, what is known and unknown, who must contribute, what blocks progress, the deadline, which decisions need approval and how completion will be verified.

"I sent the message", "I followed up" and "I completed my part" are not proof of completion. If a stakeholder does not respond, decide the next action. If a technical issue is unresolved, investigate the dependency and find a path forward. If a deadline is at risk, say so early. If you make a mistake, report it accurately and fix it.

Research and Decision Support

- Research enterprise customers, software products, competitors, AI systems, vendors and industries

- Examine primary sources, question assumptions and spot inconsistencies

- Clearly separate verified facts, estimates, interpretation and open questions

- Deliver findings, implications and recommendations, not long summaries

Customer and Business Initiatives

- Research prospective customers and prepare briefs for important conversations

- Document customer requirements and support proof-of-concept work

- Prepare structured technical and commercial material

- Make sure every customer conversation ends with clear next actions and owners

Chief of Staff Responsibilities

- Turn the Founder & CEO's priorities into plans with owners and deadlines

- Prepare decision briefs, executive summaries and program reviews that can be used without rewriting

- Keep accurate records of commitments, decisions, owners and deadlines across teams

- Surface cross-functional conflicts, clarify decision rights and escalate what needs leadership input

- Make sure decisions reach the right people accurately and follow up until they are carried out

- Maintain continuity when priorities change

- Support selected hiring research, interview preparation and onboarding

- Handle confidential company, customer and personnel information with strict discretion

Coordination does not mean authority over other functions. You will respect specialist expertise and decision rights, and recognise when a decision belongs to leadership. Access to leadership does not create authority to make personnel, contractual or commercial commitments.

HOW WE EXPECT YOU TO WORK

AI-native: You should already use tools like ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini for research, analysis, requirements and documentation. You are responsible for checking the output and must be able to explain the work without the tool. Confidential information must never go into unauthorised external tools.

Communication: Your writing must be clear, accurate and concise. You should be able to explain a technical problem to a business stakeholder and a business requirement to an engineer. When you raise an issue, state what happened, what is verified, why it matters, the options, your recommendation and the decision needed.

Judgment: We expect reliability, honest reporting of problems and mistakes, independent problem-solving before escalating, and well-reasoned disagreement. Once a decision is made, you help execute it professionally.

WHO YOU ARE

Experience: 1-5 years in a relevant role such as Associate Product Manager, Product Analyst, Technical Business Analyst, Product Operations, Software Engineer interested in product and business execution, Implementation Engineer or Analyst, Solutions Engineer, Technical Consultant, Technical Presales or Technical Customer Success. Experience supporting a founder or CEO is not required.

Education: A degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, IT, Software Engineering, AI/ML, Data Science or a closely related technical field is preferred. Others may be considered if they show strong technical understanding through professional work.

Essential skills

- Technical fluency in software, APIs, integrations and data flows

- Product understanding and the ability to interpret requirements and workflows

- Ability to take work from problem definition to verified completion

- Strong reasoning, research discipline and attention to evidence

- Fast learning in unfamiliar products and industries

- Clear professional writing and verbal communication

- Reliable follow-through, discretion and accountability

Good to have

- REST APIs, JSON and SQL

- PRD and BRD writing

- Jira, Linear, Notion or similar tools

- Software testing or technical implementation

- SaaS or AI-powered products

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

In your first three months you should be progressing toward:

- Understanding product workflows and technical dependencies independently

- Turning ambiguous requirements into useful execution plans

- Investigating technical issues instead of simply forwarding them

- Producing accurate requirements, research and decision briefs

- Separating actual completion from reported progress

- Reducing the effort leadership spends tracking your work

Early assignments are scoped to your experience, and responsibility grows as you prove your capability. Performance is judged on real work, feedback and verified outcomes, not activity.

WORKING ARRANGEMENT

Full-time, on-site in Ahmedabad, Monday to Saturday. Not remote or hybrid. Immediate or early joining is preferred. If you are currently employed, give your accurate notice period and a realistic joining date.

WHY SVECTOR

- Work directly with the Founder & CEO

- Real exposure to building and running enterprise software and AI products

- Work that connects engineering, product, customers, research and business decisions

- Growing responsibility as your capability develops

We value people who want to build strong technical and commercial judgment through real work, not just collect a more impressive title.

HOW TO APPLY (REQUIRED)

Apply through LinkedIn with your updated CV. Your application must include a short written description of one technical or business initiative you personally helped take from problem definition to completion. Cover:

- The original problem

- What you personally owned

- The technical or business challenges that came up

- What you did

- The result and how you verified it

Applications without this response will not be reviewed. Generic or AI-generated answers that you cannot explain in detail will be exposed in the interview.

title: Principal Technical Program Manager
description:
**Job Description**
Leads development and begins architecting components of scalable, elastic distributed systems. Defines and enforces scalability requirements for owned components; optimizes code and data paths for high‑throughput, hyper‑scale workloads; and leverages data plane platforms for large‑scale retrieval, storage, and processing. Designs fault‑tolerant, in‑service‑upgradable systems using redundancy, replication, failover, and policies for partitions, applying load‑shedding, throttling, and rate‑limiting to handle network unreliability while meeting SLOs. Establishes KPIs and telemetry; builds proactive dashboards and alerts; and designs complex validation (fault injection, brownouts), replication, and synchronization for correctness and durability. Proactively diagnoses and resolves production issues, mentors peers, and ensures operational readiness. Implements robust security controls, executes remediation, maintains compliance documentation, and develops IaC and automation that enable safe patching, updates, and rollbacks within change‑management plans.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Key Responsibilities
  
  
System Design & Architecture - System Scalability:
  
  
–Lead the development and implementation, and begin to architect, components of scalable distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling to meet system demands, including leveraging distributed state management tools.
  
  
–Optimize code and/or systems for large-scale data processing and high-throughput requirements to support hyper-scale systems.
  
  
–Define scalability requirements for owned components and ensure design and implementation requirements are met.
  
  
–Design systems to scale with elasticity (e.g., effectively scaling both up and down).
  
  
–Leverage data plane platforms to effectively handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing.
  
  
–Design performance and load testing.
  
  
System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design:
  
  
–Build and design fault-tolerant components and systems capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms.
  
  
–Design systems to effectively handle service disruptions (e.g., network partitions) by prioritizing consistency, availability, or partition tolerance.
  
  
–Implement and optimize approaches to handle network unreliability, including load-shedding, throttling, and rate-limiting.
  
  
–Design components and systems that are durable and adhere to service level objectives (SLOs), setting expectations for availability and durability of other computing services within the department.
  
  
System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance:
  
  
–Define key performance indicators (KPIs) and telemetry to identify gaps or issues in running systems.
  
  
–Build and customize moderately complex dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to proactively monitor components and system health..
  
  
System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability:
  
  
–Design and implement functional and correctness requirements for feature sets and/or systems in new or existing systems.
  
  
–Design complex test scenarios (e.g., fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness.
  
  
–Implement data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability.
  
  
Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management:
  
  
–Take a proactive role in diagnosing, debugging, and resolving issues in active components and systems to support ongoing operation, and mentor others in these processes.
  
  
–Implement strategies to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues.
  
  
–Maintain expertise in owned components and systems to ensure effective troubleshooting and performance.
  
  
–Meet operational readiness expectations through design and implementation.
  
  
–Serve in operational support rotations, providing guidance in incident response and root cause investigations.
  
  
Compliance & Security:
  
  
–Implement robust security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, including encryption techniques and access controls.
  
  
–Execute remediation plans to address identified security gaps.
  
  
–Ensure cloud infrastructure is in compliance with industry standards and regulations and that documentation is up to date.
  
  
Automation & Change Management:
  
  
–Develop and maintain automation scripts and tools (e.g., Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) to manage cloud infrastructure.
  
  
–Create and adhere to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications, and begin designing systems and components to allow for automation of these processes.
  
  
Core Responsibilities
  
  
Planning & Execution:
  
  
–Manages and coordinates moderately complex tasks, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure timely completion and adherence to requirements for a moderately-sized project or initiative. Efficiently delegates, monitors, and prioritizes work across multiple projects, providing technical oversight and adjusting plans to address shifts in resources or timelines.
  
  
Collaboration & Partnership:
  
  
–Collaborates across the organization to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Leverages understanding of business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to ensure proposed solutions meet their needs. Supports inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected.
  
  
Problem Solving:
  
  
–Identifies and addresses moderately complex issues by analyzing a wide range of data and/or information to identify solutions in accordance with standard practices. Proactively escalates unresolved or critical issues with a thorough assessment and suggests potential solutions. Reviews, contributes to, and documents problem solving strategies.
  
  
Continuous Learning:
  
  
–Pursues learning opportunities to expand knowledge and skills and/or tools in new areas and stays abreast of the latest industry trends and best practices. Proactively seeks and leverages ongoing feedback and training to improve skills. Coaches and mentors junior team members, fostering continuous learning and knowledge sharing within and across teams.
  
  
Continuous Improvement:

Solicits feedback from others on ideas for alternative approaches and methods for continued improvement.
  
  
Performance and Development:

title: Customer Relationship Management Consultant
description:
Customer Care Transformation Consultant

**Engagement:**
 Monthly contract. Full-time on the client through diagnostics, then a delivery role as the program moves into training and monitoring.

About the role
  

OriginBluy is running a Customer Care Gold Standard program for a large utility that serves more than 23 lakh households through 60+ walk-in service centres and an inbound call centre.

The consultant is our person on the ground: they diagnose how service works today, help define the Gold Standard, and stay through training and monitoring until the client’s own managers can hold the standard.

They report to the Principal Coach and work directly with the client’s customer care leadership, centre managers and call centre teams.

What you’ll do

**Diagnose**

* Run mystery shopping at walk-in centres: brief and calibrate the shoppers, score visits and consolidate the findings
* Select and listen to recorded calls with a focus on outliers (best, worst, repeat and escalated calls) and find the root cause of each: behaviour, process, system or policy
* Interview centre managers, call centre team leads and functional heads
* Pull together existing SOPs, scripts, QA formats and MIS into one baseline

**Define**

* Map the end-to-end customer journey for the top contact reasons, both walk-in and call
* Draft the Gold Standard: interaction standards, scripts, SOPs, escalation paths and the scorecard
* Build the cost-benefit case with client Finance: contact volumes, repeat rates, cost per contact
* Run dry runs of the new standard with a pilot group and refine it

**Deliver and sustain**

* Co-deliver CSE and manager workshops with the trainer
* Administer the Ready-for-floor certification test
* Run post-training mystery shopping and call audits, produce centre-wise scores and prepare packs for leadership reviews
* Coach centre managers and TLs to observe, score and coach against the standard

What you bring

**Must have**

* **10–15 years in customer service operations**
  , including all three of the following:
* **Inbound call centre:**
   managed or ran operations or quality for an inbound voice operation, ideally 50+ seats. Hands-on with call quality monitoring, AHT, first-contact resolution, CSAT and repeat-call analysis.
* **Walk-in service centres:**
   managed a network of customer service centres or branches. Knows queue and token management, counter processes, document-heavy service requests and how to manage a multi-location network.
* **Transformation projects:**
   led at least two service transformation or process improvement projects end to end. This could be SOP standardisation, a service redesign, a contact-centre turnaround, or harmonising processes after a merger, with results you can show.
* Comfortable with data: builds analyses in Excel, works with call logs and MIS, and can turn numbers into a business case
* Can run a good interview and a good workshop. Credible with a functional head and comfortable with a frontline executive.
* **Fluent in Gujarati, Hindi and English**
   (spoken; written Gujarati preferred)
* Willing to travel extensively within Gujarat

**Good to have**

* Experience in utilities, city gas distribution, power distribution, telecom, banking or insurance, meaning large regulated consumer bases with high volumes of service requests
* Familiarity with regulator-defined service standards and complaint timelines (e.g., PNGRB, state electricity regulatory commission norms)
* Lean, Six Sigma (Green Belt or above) or COPC exposure
* Experience with outsourced or agency staffing models in contact centres
* Training delivery or facilitation experience

What success looks like in the first 90 days

* A credible baseline from mystery shopping and call audits that the client’s leadership accepts
* A Gold Standard draft built from the client’s own best interactions, signed off by the client owner
* A cost-benefit case that the client’s Finance team has validated
* Strong working relationships with centre managers and call centre TLs, so that they see the program as support rather than an audit

Personal attributes

* Good at reading and getting on with people on the shop floor; earns trust quickly with frontline teams
* Rigorous with evidence: separates what they saw from what they were told
* Discreet with client data and with individual performance information
* Self-directed and able to run the program on the ground without close supervision

description:
**Job Description:**

**Job Title**

Bill Certification & Quantity Surveying – MEPF / HVAC

**Department**

Techno-Commercial

**Location**

TBA

**Employment Type**

Permanent

**Reports To**

Category Lead/ HOD TC

**Experience Required**

8 to 10 Years

**Project Context**

Applicable for
**high-rise, institutional, healthcare, corporate, commercial, and large-scale building projects**
involving MEPF and HVAC packages.

**Position Overview**

The role is responsible for end-to-end quantity surveying, bill certification, cost monitoring, and commercial management for MEPF and HVAC works. The position supports financial accuracy, contractual compliance, timely certification of contractor/vendor bills, cost control, variation management, and commercial reporting throughout the project lifecycle.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Review drawings, specifications, BOQs, and site execution records to verify quantities for MEPF and HVAC works.
* Prepare and validate quantity take-offs for HVAC, plumbing, fire-fighting, and allied MEP systems as applicable.
* Scrutinize contractor and vendor running bills, final bills, and supporting documents against executed quantities, approved rates, and contract terms.
* Ensure accurate bill certification with proper measurement sheets, abstracts, reconciliations, approvals, and backup documentation.
* Monitor project costs against approved budgets and highlight variances, risks, and potential cost leakages.
* Review contracts, work orders, commercial terms, and package-specific conditions for compliance and payment certification.
* Evaluate variation orders, extra items, change orders, non-tender items, and rate analysis for commercial impact.
* Support preparation of cash-flow projections, cost forecasts, MIS reports, and monthly commercial dashboards.
* Coordinate with execution, planning, procurement, design, finance, and project controls teams for quantity validation and billing closure.
* Participate in joint measurements with contractors, consultants, and internal stakeholders wherever required.
* Maintain audit-ready records for billing, certifications, approvals, measurements, and commercial correspondence.
* Support final account settlement, reconciliation of quantities, and project close-out documentation.
* Identify opportunities for value engineering and cost optimization without compromising scope, quality, safety, or compliance.

**Candidate Profile**

* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or Electrical Engineering; Mechanical preferred for HVAC-focused roles.
* Preferred additional exposure/certification in Quantity Surveying, Contracts Management, or Construction Cost Management.
* 8–10 years of relevant experience in quantity surveying, billing certification, and cost control for MEPF/HVAC works.
* Experience in large building projects such as high-rise, healthcare, institutional, corporate, commercial, or mixed-use developments.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Strong knowledge of quantity take-off and measurement verification for MEPF/HVAC works
* Expertise in contractor bill certification and final account review
* Sound understanding of BOQ, rate analysis, and contract conditions
* Cost monitoring, budgeting, and variance analysis capability
* Knowledge of variation claims, extra items, and change management
* Familiarity with drawings, specifications, and site measurement practices
* Good documentation, MIS reporting, and record management skills
* Proficiency in Excel and commercial reporting tools; exposure to QS/take-off tools is an advantage.

**Key Competencies**

* Attention to detail
* Commercial acumen
* Analytical thinking
* Cross-functional coordination
* Contractual awareness
* Documentation discipline
* Time management and follow-through
* Integrity and accuracy in certification.

**Key Deliverables (12–18 Months)**

* Timely and accurate certification of contractor and vendor bills
* Reduction in billing errors, leakages, and unsupported claims
* Improved tracking of MEPF/HVAC cost versus budget
* Complete and audit-ready measurement and billing documentation
* Effective variation and change order control
* Support for timely closure of final accounts and commercial reconciliations.

**Preferred Industry Experience**

Candidates with experience in healthcare facilities, building construction, high-rise developments, institutional projects, corporate buildings, or large infrastructure projects involving MEPF and HVAC packages will be preferred.

**Preferred Additional Requirements**

* Working knowledge of procurement ERP (i.e. SAP/ ARIBA)/ commercial systems and Microsoft Office tools.
* Ability to interpret technical submittals, BOQs, specifications, and contractual terms.
* Strong communication and negotiation capability with internal and external stakeholders.
* Experience in supplier evaluation frameworks, KPI tracking, and procurement governance practices.

title: Design Manager - Water/Wastewater Treatment
description:

Your impact
  
  
As a Design Manager – Treatment, you will lead the multidisciplinary design delivery of complex water treatment, wastewater treatment, and desalination projects. You will be responsible for driving design integration, technical excellence, programme certainty, and quality compliance across all stages of project delivery. This includes overseeing process, civil, mechanical, chemical, electrical, and I&C interfaces, ensuring alignment across all design disciplines.
  
  
You will work closely with Project Managers, Discipline Leads, and Sector/Regional leadership to plan, coordinate, and assure the technical execution of treatment projects while also mentoring and strengthening the capability of the broader design team.
  
  
Key duties include
  
  

* Development and implementation of multidisciplinary design strategies for water/wastewater treatment and desalination projects, ensuring design integration and coherent execution.
* Lead and manage the preparation, coordination, and delivery of design packages for water treatment plants, wastewater treatment plants, desalination facilities, and associated process systems.
* Evaluate, compare, and select appropriate treatment technologies and processes for project-specific needs.
* Provide leadership in Design for Design‑Build (D for DB) models—ensuring constructability, staging, risk mitigation, and alignment with contractor expectations.
* Lead or support HAZOP/HAZID studies, interpret findings, and implement appropriate mitigation measures across treatment process designs.
* Own and manage core design management documents Project Responsibility Matrix, Project Organisation Chart, Design Programme, Basis of Design, and Schedule of Deliverables.
* Identify and manage inputs from external specialists, JV partners, and sub‑consultants, ensuring their deliverables are fully integrated.
* Lead client engagement activities, including workshops, presentations, design reviews, and technical discussions.
* Facilitate multidisciplinary coordination meetings and proactively manage resolution of design issues to maintain schedule and quality commitments.
* Ensure all design outputs comply with quality standards, codes, legislation, and HSE principles, promoting safe design practices.

**We welcome applications from qualified professionals currently based overseas who are open to relocating to India. Relocation support may be provided for exceptional candidates having extensive experience in
**delivering Design Build water infrastructure projects**
.**

* Planning & Coordination Primavera P6 / MS Project

* Builds positive, collaborative relationships across diverse teams.
* Strong client‑facing presence; personable, approachable, and confident.
* Leads through coordination, communication, and engagement.
* Drives integrated, high‑quality design solutions across disciplines.
* Organised, proactive, and able to resolve complex issues promptly.
* Creative, flexible, dependable; champions safety and quality culture.

**Work Experience**

* 20+ years of experience in design management within an engineering consultancy or EPC/Design‑Build environment.
* Proven experience managing multidisciplinary design teams delivering complex treatment facilities.
* Demonstrated capability in delivering Water Treatment/ Wastewater Treatment/ Desalination across preliminary, detailed, and construction design stages.
* Strong understanding of PFDs, mass balance development, hydraulic profiles, P&IDs, and preparation of process input documents.
* Strong experience in Design for Design‑Build (D for DB), including early contractor engagement, constructability review, and technical risk mitigation.
* Experience leading design delivery in BIM‑enabled environments.
* Demonstrated interest in digital delivery and innovation, including automation, data‑driven workflows, and continuous improvement.
* Strong communication, coordination, leadership, and organisational skills.
* Experience in client presentations, tender submissions, and stakeholder management.
* Experience in change management, including assessment of design changes, impact analysis, and stakeholder communication.
* Working understanding of MTO/BoQ development and coordination with discipline teams for quantity validation.
* Ability to develop Level‑of‑Effort (LOE) estimates and support bids, proposals, and design execution plans.
* Understanding of project financials, including forecasting, progress tracking, milestone monitoring, and invoicing.
* Experience with alternate delivery methods such as Design–Build, EPC, CMAR, or PPP/P3 is an asset.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Civil, Chemical, Environmental Engineering (or related discipline)
* Master’s degree in relevant field
* Professional Engineer (PE) / Chartered Engineer (CEng) is highly desirable

**Preferred Attributes**

* Experience delivering large multidisciplinary treatment programmes (water, wastewater, or desalination).

We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work.
  
  
Your application experience is important to us, and we’re keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. title: RevOps HubSpot Specialist
description:
Who we are

York IE® is an investment and operating firm that combines a family of funds with a hands-on operating platform to build and back software companies. Job Overview

RevOps HubSpot Specialist

*Revenue Operations (RevOps) — Specialist Level*

Department & Reporting Line

Department: Revenue Operations / GTM Team

Location: Ahmedabad, India — Onsite

Reports to: RevOps Lead

Works with: Business CRM Analyst (Driver on delivery) and the RevOps Strategist / Client Owner (Approver) on every ticket, per the DACI model in the RevOps Delivery Process. Escalates directly and ad hoc to the RevOps Lead when stuck on a technical brief.

Role Summary

We are hiring a RevOps HubSpot Specialist to execute hands-on CRM configuration and GTM process builds for York IE's client engagements. This role is the core technical Contributor in the RevOps Delivery Process — building against well-defined Jira stories across HubSpot's core hubs, self-certifying QA, and growing into ownership of increasingly complex, multi-hub builds under the guidance of a RevOps Lead.

Key Responsibilities

1. HubSpot CRM Configuration & BuildConfigure and administer core HubSpot modules — Sales Hub and Marketing Hub as the primary scope, with growing, guided exposure to Service Hub, Operations Hub, and CMS Hub.
2. Build workflows, sequences, lead scoring, list segmentation, pipelines, and property/field configuration against documented acceptance criteria.
3. Set up lead routing rules, lifecycle-stage automation, and standard Marketing → Sales → Customer Success handoff logic.
4. Support HubSpot-to-Salesforce (or another adjacent tool) field mapping and sync troubleshooting under guidance from the Lead or a senior Specialist.
5. GTM Execution SupportExecute campaign tracking (UTMs), nurture flow builds, and sequence design per Marketing/Sales requirements.
6. Assist with waterfall enrichment logic and match-rate troubleshooting in coordination with data/enrichment tools (Clay, Apollo.io, ZoomInfo, Clearbit).
7. Support first-touch/last-touch attribution reporting and funnel conversion tracking.
8. Reporting & AnalyticsBuild standard HubSpot reports and dashboards tracking pipeline, campaign performance, and activity metrics.
9. Flag data-quality issues (duplicates, missing fields, broken syncs) to the Business CRM Analyst or RevOps Lead promptly.
10. Delivery Process (Contributor per DACI)Configure/build each assigned story in HubSpot against acceptance criteria set by the Business CRM Analyst.
11. Complete the Self-QA Checklist — functional test, data validation, regression check, access/permissions check, evidence attached — before moving a story to Ready for UAT.
12. Give the standing Delivery & Build Update on weekly client calls: what was configured, what passed Self-QA, what's blocked.
13. Escalate directly and promptly to the RevOps Lead when stuck on a technical brief or needing core technical guidance — an ad hoc coaching step, not a formal workflow stage.
14. Data Governance & QualityFollow the deduplication, normalization, and data hygiene standards set for the account.
15. Maintain clean documentation and evidence trails on every ticket per the Self-QA standard.
16. Required Qualifications4+ years of hands-on RevOps, Sales Ops, Marketing Ops, or CRM Admin experience, with solid working expertise in HubSpot (Sales Hub and Marketing Hub required; exposure to Service Hub, Operations Hub, or CMS Hub is a strong plus).
17. Comfortable independently building workflows, sequences, lead scoring, and reporting on well-scoped tickets.
18. Basic familiarity with Salesforce or another secondary CRM (Zoho) is a plus.
19. Exposure to GTM data/enrichment tools (Clay, Apollo.io, ZoomInfo, Clearbit) is helpful but not required.
20. Comfort working in a Jira/DACI-based delivery model — clear on when to build independently versus when to escalate.
21. Solid communication skills; comfortable giving a live build update on client calls.

Preferred / Nice-to-Have Qualifications

1. HubSpot certifications (Sales Hub Implementation, Marketing Hub Implementation, or RevOps).
2. Experience in a B2B SaaS environment.
3. Exposure to Gong, Outreach, Salesloft, or Segment.
4. Basic reporting/BI tool familiarity (Looker, Tableau, Power BI).
5. Success Metrics / What Good Looks Like in the First 90 DaysCompletes assigned stories with Self-QA evidence passing UAT on first review most of the time.
6. Comfortable running the Delivery & Build Update on weekly client calls without the Lead needing to be present.
7. Has used the ad hoc escalation path to the RevOps Lead at least once, resolving a technical blocker without it becoming a client-facing risk.
8. Shows growing independence on a second HubSpot hub beyond the core Sales/Marketing scope.
9. Soft Skills / CompetenciesDetail-oriented executor: follows acceptance criteria and QA standards precisely.
10. Proactive communicator: flags blockers early rather than at UAT.
11. Growth mindset: actively building toward multi-hub HubSpot depth.
12. Reliable ownership of assigned tickets from build through clean handoff.

Compensation & Benefits

1. A clear path to Sr. RevOps HubSpot Specialist and, eventually, RevOps Lead.
2. Structured mentorship from a RevOps Lead and technical exposure across varied clients.
3. Collaborative, high-performing RevOps delivery team.

This role is for builders growing their HubSpot depth!
*If you're hands-on with HubSpot and want to grow into full-suite RevOps ownership — not just ticket execution — we want to hear from you.*

Know more about us at https://york.ie/

title: Senior Supplier Quality Engineer
description:

* Lead supplier quality development activities including audits, assessments, and capability evaluations to ensure compliance with Grundfos standards

description:

You will guide teams on complex assignments while remaining actively involved in critical technical deliverables. You will collaborate within a multicultural, high‑performing engineering environment and contribute to achieving project targets related to quality, schedules, technical rigor, and client satisfaction.
  
  
Key duties include
  
  

* Provide technical leadership in the design and planning of water supply and wastewater conveyance networks.
* Lead and review development of hydraulic models (steady state and extended period simulations) for large-scale systems.
* Oversee master planning studies, including

+ Demand forecasting and load assessment
+ Land-use analysis
+ System capacity assessment and gap analysis

* Drive network optioneering and optimisation, ensuring cost-effective and sustainable solutions.
* Lead preparation and review of

+ Capital investment plans and phasing strategies
+ Implementation roadmaps for network expansion/upgrades

* Review and guide engineering design deliverables, including

+ Pipeline sizing and network layouts
+ Hydraulic calculations and system controls
+ Pumping systems and rising mains

* Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams (process, mechanical, civil, electrical, BIM) to ensure aligned delivery.
* Prepare and review technical reports, design basis documents, and client presentations.
* Act as a key technical interface with clients and stakeholders, supporting reviews, approvals, and technical discussions.
* Support bid/proposal development, including methodology, technical inputs, and effort estimation.
* Identify and manage technical risks, providing mitigation strategies.
* Mentor engineers and support development of technical capability within the team.
* Promote adoption of digital tools, modelling best practices, and data-driven workflows.

**delivering Design Build water infrastructure projects****
**.**

**Key software tools**

* Hydraulic Modelling WaterGEMS & SewerGEMS,
* Additional Tools (Preferred) InfoWorks ICM & InfoWorks WS Pro
* GIS ArcGIS Pro, QGIS
* Design & Coordination Civil 3D, Navisworks
* Coordination/ Clash Detection Navisworks, Revizto

**Key Behaviours**

* Strong technical authority with ability to influence engineering decisions.
* Analytical thinker with strong problem-solving capability.
* Confident communicator with effective client engagement skills.
* Collaborative and proactive in multidisciplinary environments.
* High attention to quality, accuracy, and technical integrity.
* Mentorship-oriented, with focus on developing team capability.
* Committed to continuous improvement and innovation.

**Work Experience**

* 15+ years of experience in water and wastewater conveyance planning and design.
* Strong expertise in hydraulic modelling, master planning, and detailed design of water distribution and sewer networks.
* Proven ability to lead complex modelling studies and infrastructure planning projects.
* Hands-on experience with

+ Water distribution networks
+ Wastewater collection systems (gravity + rising mains)
+ Pumping and transmission systems

* Experience in optioneering, system optimisation, and lifecycle cost analysis.
* Experience in multidisciplinary infrastructure projects and coordination.
* Exposure to Design‑Build / EPC delivery models is an advantage.
* Experience in technical reviews, QA/QC, and mentoring engineers.
* Strong familiarity with international design standards and best practices.
* Experience in technical proposal preparation and client engagement.
* Awareness of BIM-enabled design environments is desirable

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Civil or Environmental Engineering (or related discipline)

**Preferred Attributes**

* Master’s degree in Water Resources / Environmental Engineering (or relevant field)
* Chartered Engineer (CEng) / Professional Engineer (PE) preferred
* Experience in international projects and global delivery frameworks
* Ability to operate effectively in fast‑paced, client‑integrated environments.

Average office presence of 3 days per week or as per Company Policy, with travel for client/site meetings and occasional team meetings.
  
  
At Jacobs we value people. Having the right balance of belonging, career and lifestyle enables us to consistently deliver and exceed clients’ expectations.

title: Senior Manager, Business Operations (IT Staffing)
description:
**Senior Manager, Business Operations (IT Staffing)**

*Build the operating backbone of a U.S. staffing company’s India business. Ahmedabad. Reporting to the CEO.*

**Company:**
STEPS Talent Consulting Private Limited (STCPL)

**Location:**
Ahmedabad, Gujarat. On-site while the office is established and through the first 90 days; hybrid thereafter

**Type:**
Full-time. Must be able to start within 30 days of offer

**Reports to:**
Founder and CEO (U.S.)

**Manages:**
People and Operations Specialist (U.S. staffing operations); HR, Payroll and Compliance Specialist (India, planned hire); the Business Operations function as it grows

**Hours:**
Staggered India schedule, typically 2:00 PM to 11:00 PM IST, with consistent overlap with U.S. morning hours and flexibility for local business needs

**About STEPS Talent**

STEPS Talent is a U.S. enterprise technology staffing company with a growing India company, STEPS Talent Consulting Private Limited. We place ERP, Cloud, Data and AI, Cybersecurity and Software Engineering professionals with enterprise clients in the United States and India. We are establishing Ahmedabad as our permanent India headquarters and hiring the person who will run it.

**The role**

This is a founding operator role. You will not inherit a finished system. You will build one.

This is not an HR Manager, Finance Manager or administrative role. It is a hands-on business operator who knows how a staffing company runs behind the scenes.

**You own India business and financial operations end to end:**
controls, monthly close, management reporting, intercompany billing with the U.S., HR and payroll oversight, statutory compliance, and the relationships with our Chartered Accountants, Company Secretary and bankers. You set up the Ahmedabad office and lead key corporate and banking projects. You build the Business Operations team under you. And you work directly with the Founder and CEO, with no layers in between.

**What you will build in year one**

* A finance and controls function that U.S. leadership can trust without checking the work twice: approval workflows, segregation of duties, auditable records
* The Ahmedabad office: premises, vendors, infrastructure, people
* A steady working rhythm with our Chartered Accountants, Company Secretary and bankers: clear handoffs, complete documentation, deadlines met without reminders
* HR, payroll and statutory compliance (PF, ESI, TDS, Professional Tax) run by a specialist you hire and manage
* Oversight of staffing back-office operations: consultant onboarding, timesheets, billing and client portals
* The reporting rhythm: one monthly view of cash, billing, payroll, compliance and open issues
* The systems backbone across Zoho Books, Tally, HRMS and our staffing platforms

**What good looks like at 90 days**

* Monthly close, reporting and compliance running on schedule without CEO intervention
* The Ahmedabad office and professional relationships operating with clear ownership
* The first management dashboard live, and a prioritized systems plan for the next two quarters

**Who does well here**

* 10+ years in business operations, ideally IT staffing or professional services, with hands-on ownership of India finance operations: monthly close, reconciliations, vendor payments, payroll controls, management reporting
* Has worked directly with Chartered Accountants, tax professionals and payroll providers, and keeps ownership inside the company
* Reads a P&L, balance sheet and cash flow and turns them into management action
* 5+ years managing people; working knowledge of Indian HR, payroll and employment compliance
* Working knowledge of U.S. staffing back-office operations: consultant lifecycle, W-2 and C2C, timesheets, client billing
* Has built processes, controls and reporting in a growing company and been personally accountable for the result. Been there, done that
* A problem-solver who owns outcomes: resolves issues at their level, escalates with options rather than questions, and does not need the CEO to close every open item
* Clear writer and speaker; discreet; comfortable working directly with U.S. leadership

**Preferred:**
Zoho Books, Zoho People, Tally, QuickBooks or comparable systems; SAP Fieldglass, SAP Ariba or similar MSP and VMS platforms; intercompany billing across related companies in different countries; setting up a new office or managing external advisers.

**Why this role**

* Founding seat in a new India headquarters, with the authority to design how it runs
* Direct line to the CEO. Your work is seen, and your decisions carry
* Cross-border scope: U.S. and India finance, tax, compliance and staffing operations in one role
* A path to Head of India Business Operations as the company grows

Send your resume directly to Sunny Patel at
**Sunny.Patel@stepstalent.com**
, copying
**Shree.Singh@stepstalent.com**
, with the
**subject line “Senior Manager, Business Operations (IT Staffing) - Ahmedabad”**
.

In three lines, tell us the hardest operations problem you have fixed. Direct applicants only.

**About The Position**
**Sr Project Manager – Global PMO**
The Kraft Heinz Global Business Services (GBS) organization is establishing a program management team consisting of senior Project and Program Management professionals to lead high-profile, complex transformation, transition, and technology transformation projects. The Sr Project Manager takes responsibility for stakeholder management across the wider program audience, engages with senior leadership, provides structured recommendations, and acts as a delivery partner across transformation strategy, transition planning, technology implementation, risk management, and business readiness.
