title: Production Manager
description:
**Company Description**
Osé Studios is a design-driven ready-to-wear brand founded by sisters Twishaa and Nishika Bhagat, focused on non-seasonal collections and everyday staples that remain relevant over time. The studio emphasizes versatility, creating pieces that transition seamlessly from work to weekend and casual moments to polished occasions. Each collection reflects a commitment to slow, considered fashion that honors craftsmanship and celebrates individual style. By producing limited runs and prioritizing fabric integrity, Osé Studios cultivates a community-driven approach, inviting ongoing dialogue with wearers and shaping a refined made-in-India fashion narrative.

**Role Description:**
The Production Manager at Osé Studios will oversee end-to-end production processes for ready-to-wear collections, ensuring quality, timelines, and cost targets are met. This full-time, on-site role in Ahmedabad includes coordinating with design, sourcing, and manufacturing partners, planning production schedules, and monitoring workflow from sampling to final delivery. The role involves supervising factory and vendor relationships, resolving production issues, and enforcing quality standards aligned with the brand’s craftsmanship and fabric integrity. The Production Manager will track inventory and production metrics, optimize resources, and support continuous improvements in efficiency, sustainability, and ethical practices. The role also contributes to cross-functional communication, providing regular status updates and aligning production priorities with collection launches and business goals.

**Qualifications**

* Strong production management skills, including planning, coordination, and workflow oversight within fashion or apparel manufacturing.
* Experience with vendor and factory management, including negotiation, capacity planning, and relationship building with supply chain partners.
* Knowledge of garment construction, fabric types, quality control standards, and ready-to-wear production processes.
* Proficiency in using production tracking tools or software, and comfort with spreadsheets and basic data analysis.
* Excellent organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple collections and deadlines simultaneously.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively with design, merchandising, and operations teams.
* Prior experience in slow fashion, ethical production, or limited-run collections is an advantage.
* Demonstrated ability to work on-site in Ahmedabad and be present on the production floor as needed.

title: Web Development Team Lead
description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced Web Development Team Lead to manage our web development department and oversee website projects from client onboarding to final delivery.

The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience in WordPress, Shopify, PHP, full-stack development, eCommerce websites, hosting and web applications. They should also be comfortable managing a team, communicating directly with Australian clients, understanding project requirements and ensuring websites are delivered on time with high quality.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Team Management**

* Manage and guide the web development team, including developers and designers.
* Assign tasks based on team members' skills, workload and project priorities.
* Monitor productivity, project progress and individual performance.
* Support the team in resolving technical issues and improving development skills.

**2. Project Management and Delivery**

* Manage multiple website projects simultaneously, from onboarding to launch.
* Understand client requirements and convert them into clear tasks for the team.
* Plan project timelines, allocate resources and ensure deadlines are met.
* Monitor project progress, identify delays and take corrective action.
* Ensure websites are properly tested, functional, responsive and ready for launch.
* Maintain project status, planned versus actual launch dates, delays and team workload.

**3. Client Communication**

* Communicate directly with Australian clients to understand their requirements and provide project updates.
* Manage website onboarding, requirement gathering, feedback and revisions.
* Coordinate with clients to resolve issues and clarify technical requirements.
* Manage website handovers after completion, ensuring clients receive the required access and documentation.
* Handle client concerns professionally and escalate major issues when required.

**4. Technical Expertise**

* Lead development projects using WordPress, Shopify, PHP and other relevant web technologies.
* Oversee full-stack development, eCommerce websites, custom functionality and web applications.
* Manage hosting, domains, website migrations, deployments, backups and technical troubleshooting.
* Review website speed, security, responsiveness, functionality and overall performance.
* Guide the team in resolving complex technical issues and preventing recurring errors.

**5. Quality Assurance and Process Improvement**

* Ensure websites are tested before delivery, including functionality, mobile responsiveness, forms, integrations and performance.
* Work with designers, developers, SEO specialists, Paid ads team,  and account managers to ensure smooth project execution.
* Introduce processes and checklists to reduce errors, rework and delivery delays.
* Use AI-based tools and automation where appropriate to improve development speed, code quality and team productivity.
* Maintain clear project documentation, delivery reports and handover records.

**6. Cross-Team Coordination and Internal Communication**

* Work closely with Account Managers to understand client requirements, project scope, priorities and deadlines.
* Coordinate with SEO, Google Ads, Meta Ads and Content teams to ensure website requirements are properly understood and implemented.
* Ensure SEO requirements, tracking codes, conversion tracking, landing pages, content updates and other marketing requirements are completed before website launch, wherever applicable.
* Maintain clear and timely communication with all relevant teams regarding project progress, pending tasks, dependencies, changes and delays.
* Proactively follow up with team members and other departments to avoid communication gaps and project delays.
* Ensure all requirements and feedback from clients and internal teams are documented and communicated clearly to the development team.
* Inform Account Managers and relevant stakeholders about project status, technical issues, timeline changes and launch readiness.
* Take ownership of resolving cross-team issues and escalating major blockers when required.
* Ensure a smooth handover between the development team, Account Managers and other relevant teams after website completion.

**Required Skills and Experience**

* 7+ years of hands-on web development experience, with at least 2 years in a team lead or similar leadership role.
* Strong practical experience in WordPress and Shopify development.
* Good knowledge of PHP, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, databases, APIs and full-stack development.
* Experience with eCommerce websites, custom web applications, hosting and website deployment.
* Experience managing multiple projects and coordinating a development team.
* Strong client communication and requirement-gathering skills.
* Good written and spoken English, with the confidence to communicate with Australian clients.
* Strong problem-solving, planning, time management and decision-making skills.
* Experience with website testing, quality control, security and performance optimisation.
* Ability to use AI development tools and automation to improve efficiency and quality.
* Strong internal communication and coordination skills, with the ability to work effectively with Account Managers and SEO, Google Ads, Meta Ads and Content teams.
* Ability to understand requirements from both technical and digital marketing perspectives and convert them into clear development tasks.
* Strong follow-up, documentation and stakeholder management skills to ensure smooth coordination and timely project delivery.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working in a digital marketing agency or web development agency.
* Experience handling 20–30+ active client accounts or multiple concurrent website projects.
* Experience working with international clients, particularly Australian clients.
* Experience with project management tools, workflow automation and AI-assisted development.

**What We Expect From This Role**

The person will take ownership of the web development department's day-to-day operations, team performance, client communication, technical quality and project delivery. They should be capable of managing multiple projects independently while keeping management informed about progress, risks and delays.

title: Automation Lead
description:
**Company Description**
Amratpal A Vision is a student-focused study abroad consultancy dedicated to helping ambitious learners turn their global education aspirations into achievable careers. Founded by Mr. Amratpal Singh Sohal, a former German student and IIM-Ahmedabad-trained entrepreneur, the organization offers end-to-end services for study destinations in Germany, Canada, the USA, and the UK. The team supports students through university selection, SOP writing, visa filing, language training, airport pickup, and settlement assistance, ensuring a smooth transition to international education. Guided by values of mentorship, clarity, and community, Amratpal A Vision emphasizes long-term success rather than short-term marketing. With 10,000+ success stories and a strong international alumni network, the company is recognized as one of India’s most trusted visa consultants, particularly for German education.
  
**Role Description**
The Automation Lead is a full-time on-site role based in Ahmedabad, responsible for designing, implementing, and managing automation solutions that improve operational efficiency across key business processes. This role involves analyzing current workflows, identifying automation opportunities, and creating robust test cases to validate new or updated automated systems. The Automation Lead will oversee quality assurance activities related to automation, perform troubleshooting for issues, and collaborate with counselors, operations staff, and technology partners to ensure reliable and scalable solutions. The position also includes documenting automation standards, training team members on new tools or processes, and continuously monitoring performance to drive incremental improvements.
  
**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong skills in Process Automation and Automation tools to streamline and optimize business workflows.
* Candidates should possess solid Troubleshooting abilities to diagnose, resolve, and prevent automation-related issues.
* Candidates should possess skills in Test Cases and Quality Assurance to validate functionality, reliability, and performance of automated processes.
* Relevant experience in operations, IT, or business process management, preferably in education, consulting, or service-oriented environments.
* Ability to translate business needs into technical requirements and communicate solutions clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong analytical and organizational skills, with attention to detail and a focus on accuracy and compliance.
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience with workflow automation platforms, scripting, or RPA tools is an advantage.

* Desired Qualification : BE/Btech

* Lead and execute CQV activities across multiple CQV projects, ensuring timely execution and compliance with industry regulations.

* Manage multi-disciplinary teams including CQV engineers, vendors, and contractors.
* Serve as the primary CQV interface with clients, design teams and Quality & regulatory teams.
* Track project deliverables, budgets, risks, and timelines and provide regular project updates and status reports to stakeholders.
* Drive decision-making and resolve escalations with engineering team and client.
* Involve in GMP review of layouts and systems and ensure CQV requirements are embedded early in the design lifecycle.
* Review P&IDs, layouts, URS, FS/DS, equipment specifications and vendor documentation.
* Mentor and guide CQV engineers and junior staff.
* Establish best practices, templates, and standard methodologies.
* Drive continuous improvement and knowledge sharing within the team.
* Prepare C&Q plans in line with the strategic goals of the client and manage timely and compliant delivery of the plan.
* Ensure all commissioning and qualification procedures are implemented and adhered to at office and at site level.
* Complete the development, review and execution of validation plans, URSs/DQ/TMs/FATs/SATs/IQ/OQ protocols/reports.
* Ensure all CQV activities comply with relevant regulatory requirements (e.g., FDA, EMA) and industry standards (e.g., ISPE, ASTM) and meets data integrity (ALOCOA+) principles. Well versed in commissioning and qualifying CIP & SIP systems

Here's what you'll need
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Life Sciences, or a related field. Advanced degree preferred. B. Pharm., M. Pharm., B.Tech or BE or MSc.

title: Supplier Development Professional – Specialist
description:
**About Milacron**
We serve the primary market segment: Milacron Injection, Molding & Extrusion (MIME), which designs, manufactures, and sells injection and extrusion equipment, co-injection systems and related parts and services.
  
  
**THE ROLE**
The Milacron Supplier Development group, a global and progressive function within Milacron, is currently seeking strong, results-oriented candidates for the positions as a Supplier Quality Professional ranging from Specialist to Engineer.
  
  
Reporting to Global Supplier Development, this position will support, facilitate, and lead Supplier Development actions for multiple regional facilities. The role focuses on supply chain performance with responsibility for supplier quality, assessing supplier capability, verifying the quality of purchased items at the source, providing timely and accurate supplier performance metrics, facilitating continuous improvement and training of the supporting supply base. In this role you will manage the resolution of supplier quality issues at the regional facilities as well as global suppliers for specific categories.
  
  
As part of the Supplier Development organization, you will provide technical guidance in the use of quality management tools incorporating the technical disciplines found in FAI, PPAP, SPC, FMEA, Control Plans and Problem Analysis. Coordinate formal supplier training to drive consistency in process, including supplier continuous improvement and development programs. Work with underperforming suppliers to improve On-time Delivery (OTD) and non-conformance rates using improvement tools like 8Ds, A3’s, etc. Review and maintain evaluations of perspective suppliers and existing supplier performance, report status of supplier performance, and proactively act when quality trends indicate such action is warranted. Serve as liaison between engineering, procurement, quality and production to assure quality and reliability from the supply base. In addition, you will help build and sustain a strategic supply base that aligns with the corporate category management team strategy.
  
  
**General Characteristics**
***To perform this job successfully, the candidate will possess the skills, aptitudes, and abilities to perform the essential duties proficiently.***

* Process and results driven with strong project management skills
* Have functional working knowledge of Quality Engineering principles
* Be a self-starter with a proven ability to manage supplier improvement initiatives
* Strategically lead supplier performance improvement projects to increase the supplier capability of consistently meeting Milacron requirements
* Must be able to establish cross functional relationships and partnerships through your product and process knowledge
* Implement and monitor the part qualification and certification process with elected suppliers
* Champion problem solving and root cause analysis activities with suppliers and customers to eliminate recurrence of non-conformances
* Function as liaison between procurement, engineering, manufacturing and suppliers to resolve supplier quality issues and to provide technical support
* Work to resolve supplier technical issues in a timely manner to ensure continuity of supply
* Support leadership and maintain a high level of performance in carrying out the goals of the department and corporation
* Review targeted supplier manufacturing processes, evaluate supplier root cause corrective actions relative to those processes and confirm identified failure modes.
* Ability to travel (up to 50%) is required

**Experience**

* 5+ years of experience in Supplier Development, Manufacturing Quality or Supplier Quality Engineering in a manufacturing environment or Comparable Work Experience
* Understanding of Print Reading and Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerance (GD&T)
* Experience in Casting, Machining and Machined Components is preferred
* Experience in facilitating change and working with cross functional teams including engineering and manufacturing
* Experience in a high mix low volume global business is desired
* Familiarity in auditing supplier manufacturing processes and quality systems
* Familiarity with US and International Industry measurement standards and tools
* Familiarity with quality standards such as ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and compliance auditing experience
* Experience in using structured problem solving to drive acute and chronic quality issues to closure

**Education**

* B.E/B. Tech degree from an accredited 4-year college or university in a technical or supply chain related discipline or equivalent combination of education and experience with a minimum of 4 years of experience in Quality, Manufacturing, Shop Operations, Materials or Sourcing
* Proficient oral and written communication skills
* Proficient in English language (verbal and written communications).

**Who We Are**
Milacron is a global industrial leader in the manufacturing and distribution of highly engineered and customized injection molding and extrusion solutions, and aftermarket parts and service for the plastics processing industry. The company’s 1,900+ associates worldwide collaborate to serve a diverse range of end-markets, such as automotive, construction, medical, telecommunications, material handling, packaging, and much more. With expertise in plastics spanning nearly 60 years, Milacron holds longstanding relationships with more than 27,000 customers around the world. The original equipment provider of plastics manufacturing solutions is the largest US-owned and globally served of its kind. Headquartered in Batavia, OH, Milacron’s global footprint is also serviced through regional facilities in Asia, Europe, and South America.

We are committed to being an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Employer and offer opportunities to all job seekers including individuals with disabilities. title: Senior Manager - NetSuite Enterprise Applications and Architecture
description:
**About the Company:**

Relay Human Cloud is a young & dynamic company that helps some of the top US-based companies to expand their team internationally. Relay is a truly global company having its operations in US, India, Honduras, and Mexico (We are also adding a few more countries soon). Our core focus is to enable companies to connect with the best international talent. Relay helps its clients in majorly following areas: Accounting & Finance, Administration, Operations, Space Planning, Leasing, Data Science, Data Search, Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence etc. Relay India operates from Ahmedabad and Vadodara offices. The principals and founders of Relay Human Cloud have been focused on delivering high-quality operations in cutting-edge companies for their entire careers.

**Job Summary:**

The Senior Manager, NetSuite Enterprise Applications & Architecture will lead hands-on NetSuite implementation, configuration, testing, deployment, and ongoing platform ownership. The role requires strong expertise in NetSuite financials, inventory, procurement, order management, and distribution workflows. The ideal candidate will drive solution design, validate business processes, maintain financial controls, and ensure a scalable, reliable ERP environment.

**Responsibilities:**

**NetSuite implementation and solution ownership**

* Participate directly in solution design, configuration, prototyping, testing, deployment, hypercare, and stabilization.
* Learn and document company's current processes, legacy applications, business rules, controls, data structures, and operational dependencies before replacing or redesigning them.
* Translate business requirements into practical NetSuite designs that favor standard functionality when it meets the business need.
* Review partner-proposed designs, identify gaps and downstream consequences, and challenge recommendations that create avoidable complexity, weak controls, or poor operational outcomes.
* Own material application design decisions and maintain functional architecture, configuration, decision, and support documentation.

**Financial management and controls**

* Support the design and configuration of general ledger, accounts payable, accounts receivable, cash management, bank reconciliation, intercompany activity, financial dimensions, allocations, fixed assets, and period close
* Understand and validate the accounting consequences of transaction design across sales, purchasing, inventory, fulfillment, billing, returns, credits, and adjustments
* Protect subledger-to-general-ledger integrity through reconciliations, conversion validation, controlled posting logic, and clear exception handling.
* Partner with Finance to establish approvals, role permissions, audit trails, segregation of duties, and other control requirements.
* Validate financial reporting outputs and ensure configuration supports accurate, explainable, and repeatable close processes.

**Order to cash and customer operations**

* Design and support customer master data, sales orders, pricing, allocations, fulfillment, invoicing, payments, returns, credits, and related workflows.
* Support both owned-inventory and drop-ship transaction models, including customer-specific item references and order requirements.
* Evaluate the effect of design choices on customer service, warehouse execution, fulfillment accuracy, margin, and accounting.
* Work with process owners to define exceptions, approvals, controls, and measurable acceptance criteria for end-to-end customer transactions.

**Procure to pay inventory and warehouse processes**

* Design and support vendor master data, purchasing, purchase orders, receiving, vendor bills, matching, landed cost, payments, and returns.
* Support item master design, units of measure, locations, lot traceability, transfers, adjustments, cycle counts, costing, and inventory reconciliation.
* Address food-distribution requirements such as master case and break pack, assemblies, repack, catch weight, lot control, and related accounting flows when applicable.
* Confirm that application design works in the operating environment and does not shift hidden effort or control risk into warehouse, procurement, customer service, or Finance teams.

**Configuration administration and release governance**

* Configure or oversee roles, permissions, forms, fields, workflows, saved searches, dashboards, approval processes, and application preferences.
* Establish standards for configuration, customization, SuiteFlow, SuiteScript, naming, documentation, and environment management.
* Evaluate native functionality before approving extensions and ensure each customization has a clear owner, business purpose, test plan, and support approach.
* Maintain disciplined development, test, sandbox, and production practices with documented change control and release procedures.
* Support production issues, perform root-cause analysis, and manage an enhancement backlog based on business value, control risk, and operational need.

**Master data testing and cutover**

* Help define customer, vendor, item, pricing, chart-of-accounts, location, and other master-data structures, ownership, approval rights, and system-of-record boundaries.
* Participate in data mapping, cleansing, conversion, validation, and reconciliation with clear acceptance criteria.
* Develop and execute end-to-end test scenarios covering normal transactions, exceptions, integrations, financial posting, operational handoffs, and reporting.
* Take an active role in conference-room pilots, system and integration testing, user acceptance testing, cutover rehearsals, go-live readiness, and hypercare.
* Reject incomplete testing or unresolved defects that could compromise financial integrity, inventory accuracy, customer service, or operational continuity.

**Long term platform ownership**

* Become a primary internal owner and subject-matter expert for the NetSuite application environment.
* Build sufficient internal knowledge to reduce unnecessary dependence on outside consultants while using specialized partners where they add value.
* Maintain current documentation, operating procedures, configuration standards, training materials, and decision history.
* Evaluate new capabilities and enhancements against business value, total cost, control implications, operational impact, and supportability.
* Help establish a scalable ERP operating model that can support organic growth, new operating requirements, and future acquisitions.

**Qualifications:**

* More than 7 years of ERP implementation, enterprise applications, or ERP administration experience, including at least five years of meaningful hands-on NetSuite experience.
* Participation in at least one full-cycle NetSuite implementation with direct responsibility for design, configuration, testing, conversion, cutover, or stabilization.
* Strong knowledge of NetSuite financials and core ERP capabilities, including general ledger, accounts payable, accounts receivable, order management, purchasing, and inventory.
* Working knowledge of accounting fundamentals, inventory accounting, financial controls, reconciliations, and subledger-to-general-ledger integrity.
* Demonstrated ability to understand complex business processes and translate them into practical, supportable system designs.
* Hands-on experience with roles, permissions, workflows, saved searches, reporting, master data, data conversion, and test execution.
* Ability to assess operational impacts and work effectively with Finance, procurement, operations, warehouse, customer service, and technology teams.
* Ability to evaluate and challenge consultant or vendor recommendations using business, accounting, control, data, and operational evidence.
* Strong documentation, troubleshooting, communication, and decision-making skills.
* Willingness to remain hands-on throughout implementation and long-term operation of the platform.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* NetSuite OneWorld experience and relevant NetSuite certifications.
* Food distribution, wholesale distribution, manufacturing, or another inventory-intensive industry background.
* Experience with lot-controlled inventory, catch weight, repack, assemblies, drop ship, EDI-enabled transactions, or complex pricing.
* Experience migrating from Microsoft Dynamics GP or another legacy ERP.
* Familiarity with SuiteFlow, SuiteScript, SuiteAnalytics, NetSuite APIs, and integration concepts.
* Experience supporting multi-entity or acquisition-driven organizations.

**Why Join Relay Human Cloud? ✨**

🌍 Opportunities to work with global clients

🤝 Dynamic and collaborative work environment

⚖️ Excellent work-life balance – 5-day workweek

🩺 Comprehensive health & accident insurance

🌴 Generous paid time off and holidays

🍽️ Complimentary lunches & dinners

🏆 Quarterly, Semi-Annual & Annual recognition, rewards, and giveaways

📚 Employee development programs – Communication, Soft Skills, and more

🎉 Vibrant cultural events – Fun Fridays, Month-End Celebrations, Sports Tournaments, and Festival celebrations

🎯 Excellent Employee Referral Program

title: Assistant Manager Manufacturing Engineering
description:
****About SKF****

SKF started its operations in India in 1923. Today, SKF provides through its five technology-centric platforms: bearings and units, seals solutions and services. Over the years the company has evolved from manufacturing company to a knowledge-driven engineering company sustainable and competitive business excellence.

SKF's solutions provide sustainable ways for companies across the sectors to achieve breakthroughs in friction reduction, energy efficiency and reliability. With a strong commitment to research-based innovation value-added solutions that integrate all its five technology platforms. About the organization: www.skf.com/in

**SKF Purpose Statement**

Together, we re-imagine rotation for a better tomorrow.

By creating intelligent and clean solutions for people and the planet

**Job Title:**
Assistant Manager Manufacturing Engineering

**Reports to:**
Deputy General Manager - Engineering & Projects

**Role Type:**
Individual Contributor

**Job Location:**
Bavla, Ahmedabad (Nodal Pick-up Drop available from Ahmedabad city)

**Working days:**
Alternate Saturdays will be working

**Purpose of the role:**

Responsible for working on identified plant level process improvement and process implementation activities and execution of new product development. Also provide technical assistance & solutions for smooth running of manufacturing processes.

**Responsibilities:**

* Cycle time improvement: Drive process improvements in identified manufacturing processes for cycle reduction, Develop and implement solutions to improve OEE and reduce operator fatigue.
* Work on New Product development on channel to ensure right process design and achieve product characteristics as per SKF specifications. Plan & execute industrialization for new bearing types.
* Introduction of new Cutting tools and abrasives (Grinding,Turning & Honing) for output improvement & cost reduction.
* Takes part in PFMEA, Control plan and other channel documents for New Product Development and revision of existing products.
* Works on technology improvement projects like vision cameras and advanced manufacturing techniques.
* Drive New Channel development & machine installation projects (Channel layouts, grinding/assembly, automation).
* Leads Machine Qualification by using Techniques like FAT and SAT.
* Works on ECR for effective implementation of change management.
* Release Process flow diagram, Set up chart, process validation report & Process Drawings for new product development.
* Develop tooling requirements for grinding, honing, and assembly processes by applying SMED concepts. Ensure tooling performance during prove ‑ out and ramp ‑ up.

**Metrics:**

* Cycle time Improvement and Fixing deviation.
* No. of New product Developed
* Productivity Improvement and OEE Improvement.
* Installation of new machines & equipment.

**Competencies:**

* Sound Knowledge of Turning, Hard Turning, Hard Machining, (Grinding & Honing will be added) Assembly process.
* Knowledge of CAD/CAM systems, geometric dimensioning and tolerance, Hand on experience on 3D modelling software E.g. Creo and 2D modelling software E.g. AutoCAD.
* Good Understanding of Process Flow diagrams, PFEA, Control Plan and MSA.
* Machine Qualification Technique, FAT and SAT.
* Learning Agility, problem solving mindset
* Exposure to advanced manufacturing technique, digitization, robotics. Low cost automation
* Effective team player

**Candidate Profile:**

* 7-10 yrs. of relevant experience in Manufacturing Engg.
* Bachelor's in Engg. (Mechanical/Industrial/Production)

Interested candidate/s can share their resume to
**Supriya.Joshi@skf.com**

****About SKF****

SKF has been around for more than a century and today we are one of the world’s largest global suppliers of bearings and supporting solutions for rotating equipment. With more than 40,000 employees in around 130 countries, we are truly global. Our products are found everywhere in society. In fact, wherever there is movement, SKF’s solutions might be at work. This means that we are an important part of the everyday lives of people and companies around the world. See more, at www.skf.com.

title: Sr. Manager, Professional Services
description:
**A career that’s the whole package!**
At Conga, we’ve built a community where our colleagues can thrive. Here you’ll find opportunities to innovate and support growth through individual and team development, all within an environment where every voice is heard.
  
  
**Conga**
lines up commercial operations so companies run as connected, smarter businesses. By unifying the people and processes that drive commerce, Conga aligns pricing, quoting, contracting, rebates, and communications so teams stay in sync and buyers keep moving forward. The result is trusted decisions, consistent buyer experiences, and profitable growth. More than 10,000 customers worldwide, including over 50% of the Fortune 100®, trust Conga when commercial complexity is high and global impact is on the line.
  
  
**Job Title**
: Senior Manager, PS
  
  
**Locations**
: Ahmedabad
  
  
**Reports to**
: Regional Vice President, Professional Services
  
  
**A career that’s the whole package!**
At Conga, we’ve built a community where our colleagues can thrive. Here you’ll find opportunities to innovate, support for growth through individual and team development, and an environment where all voices can be heard.
  
  
**Conga**
crushes complexity within an increasingly complex world. With our revenue lifecycle management solution, we transform your unique complexities for order configuration, execution, fulfillment, and contract renewal processes with a single critical insights data model that adapts to ever-changing business requirements and aligns the understanding and efforts of every team.
  
  
**Our mission**
: Empower customers to deliver transformational revenue growth by aligning teams, processes, and technology to maximize customer lifetime value.
  
  
Our approach is grounded in the Conga Way, a framework for what we stand for and everything we do as an organization — from hiring to decision making and product development. Developed with direct input from our colleagues, the Conga Way is the foundation for our culture.
  
  
**A quick snapshot**
**…**
A Senior Manager will build and manage an effective team from offshore centre. It includes hiring, training, coaching, retaining, and measuring the effectiveness of a high-performing PS delivery team. Be a problem solver and a guide, coach, mentor, and a strong communicator.
  
  
**Why it’s a big deal…**
The Senior Manager will play a key role in building a strong and effective team who will deal with different situations while working on the projects.
  
  
**Are you the person we’re looking for?**
**Related experience.**
Must have 15+ years of experience in the IT industry, with strong experience in building and managing high-performing teams. Should have solid experience coordinating with global and offshore teams, along with full lifecycle enterprise software implementation experience. Experience working with Conga products such as CPQ and CLM, or with any CRM or SaaS platform, will be a strong added advantage.
  
  
**Strong communication and interpersonal skills.**
You’re not just comfortable engaging in collaborative discussions, but initiating them, too. You are skilled at reading and adapting to different communication styles, and when you speak you are clear and concise. Your strong listening skills foster connection with our customers and stakeholders and allow you to accurately gather the right information so you can resolve issues in the most effective way.
  
  
**Natural collaborator.**
You work effectively across functions — with Delivery Teams, Practice Directors, Regional Heads and customer stakeholders — to drive successful project outcomes. You are proficient with Agile and have a collaborative, cross-functional approach to delivering great solutions. You are comfortable working across multiple teams and championing best practices. You constantly seek opinions and solicit feedback to create the best work possible. You don’t know any other way, It’s a team effort and you completely appreciate that.
  
  
**People leadership and development.**
You take genuine ownership of your team — hiring, coaching, mentoring, and retaining top talent. You invest in each individual’s career growth and skill expansion, building clear development paths and a culture where people do their best work and want to stay.
  
  
**Driving initiatives and an AI-first mindset.**
You lead organizational initiatives that raise the bar for delivery, and you champion AI-driven ways of working to improve efficiency, quality, and customer outcomes. You proactively identify opportunities to innovate and bring your team along with you.
  
  
**Subject matter expertise.**
You serve as a trusted subject matter expert for Conga’s enterprise customers, understanding their business challenges and how our solutions solve them. You bring credibility to customer conversations and help your team navigate complex enterprise implementations.
  
  
**Education.**
A bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related technical field is highly preferred.
  
  
**Here’s What Will Give You An Edge…**
**Passion**
. We know it when we see it. Passion is not about saying how much you love what you do in your most excited voice. Passion is revealed in your truest self. It’s about what you’ve accomplished; how you want to grow; the ideas you have; your philosophies. It’s demonstrating through your words and your actions that you truly believe in what you do -- and where you work. That it matters to you. And that’s pretty cool.
  
  
**Initiative**
. You don’t wait around for things to happen or for your manager to tell you what to do. You’re not only proactive about completing your own work, but when you sense the need to introduce a project that will benefit the team or the organization -- even if it’s outside your scope of work -- you put a proposal together, talk to the team about it, and
*own it*
. And that also goes back to having an entrepreneurial spirt
  
  
**Did we pique your interest?**
If this sounds like the kind of job you would love in the kind of environment where you would thrive, please click apply. We'd love to hear from you!
  
  
**Preferred Resume Format**
We accept resumes in any format, we suggest using PDF or plain text. These formats help ensure that your resume’s formatting remains intact, making it easier for our recruiters to review your application promptly.
  
  
**Don’t meet every requirement for the role?**


Studies have shown that women and members of ethnic minorities are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Conga we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You just might be the right candidate for this or other roles.
  
  
Additional Information
  
  
Conga is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, parental or pregnancy status, marriage and civil partnership, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We understand interviewing can be stressful for those with disabilities. If reasonable accommodation is needed to allow you to show us your best self, please let your recruiter know as soon as possible. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Conga is not open to third party solicitation or resumes for our posted FTE positions. Resumes received from third party agencies that are unsolicited will be considered complimentary.
  
  
**Conga's Applicant Privacy Statement**
The information you provide during the application process will be used in accordance with Conga’s Applicant Privacy Statement (https://conga.com/applicant-privacy-statement). By submitting your application, you acknowledge and agree to the terms outlined in this privacy statement.

title: Creative Project Manager
description:
**Creative Project Manager**

Because — Ahmedabad · Full-time · On-site

We're
**Because**
— an AI-native brand and marketing agency working across education, real estate, lifestyle, sports and financial services. This role is for someone who is genuinely two things at once: sharp enough to run client relationships, and creative enough to do the actual work. You'll own 4–6 accounts, report directly to a senior strategist, and be expected to think, write, plan, coordinate, and execute — often on the same day. If that sounds exhausting rather than exciting, this probably isn't the right fit.

**What you'll own**

* Manage 3–4 client accounts end-to-end — timelines, feedback cycles, approvals, and proactive communication. Clients should never have to follow up with you.
* Develop content strategy and campaign concepts — not just execute briefs, but help shape what the brief should be in the first place.
* Write copy across formats — social captions, scripts, brand messaging, ad copy, emailers — in English, Hindi, or Gujarati depending on the client.
* Build client presentations and strategy decks that make a clear argument and hold the room.
* Contribute to pitches — own your section, know the prospect's business, and present with conviction.
* Plan and coordinate shoots — brief photographers and videographers, prepare shot lists and call sheets, manage on-ground logistics, and ensure the output matches the creative vision.
* Write scripts for reels, brand films, ads, and talking-head content — punchy, platform-aware, and on-brief.
* Reference and brief designers and video editors with enough visual and tonal direction that they don't have to guess what you want.
* Manage social media hands-on for select clients — content calendars, scheduling, captions, and community responses.
* Coordinate with external vendors — studios, talent, print vendors, photographers — and hold them to timelines and quality standards.

**You're a fit if**

* You have 3–4 years at a creative or marketing agency and you've genuinely done both sides — not just one with a footnote of the other.
* You can write in at least two of the three: English, Hindi, Gujarati. Fluency in all three is a real advantage here.
* You can hold a client conversation in the morning, brief a designer at noon, review a script by evening, and not mix up which client is which.
* Your strategy thinking is grounded — you back ideas with audience insight, not just instinct.
* You've been on set. You know what a shot list is, how to manage a photographer who runs late, and what "we'll fix it in post" actually costs.
* You use AI tools actively — for copy drafts, research, referencing, strategy frameworks — and you've built your own workflow around them.
* You push back on bad briefs and bad ideas — politely, with reasoning — rather than just executing whatever lands in your inbox.
* Nothing falls through the cracks on your accounts. Not because someone's checking, but because that's just how you work.

**Work samples are mandatory.**
Share a deck you built, copy you wrote, a campaign you managed, or a shoot you coordinated.

description:
Job description:
   

  


 Scicore Nutra Private Limited (wholly owned subsidiary of Glanbia Nutritionals (Ireland)) is a state\-of\-the\-art facility, located in Sanand Gujarat, dedicated to producing high\-quality nutrition products that are safe, effective, and meet the highest standards of quality. Our team of experts is committed to ensuring that every product we manufacture is produced with the utmost care and attention to detail.
 



  

 At our manufacturing unit, we use only the best raw materials and employ advanced manufacturing processes to ensure that our products are of the highest quality. We also adhere to strict quality control measures to ensure that every product meets our rigorous standards. This starts with doing a rigorous vendor qualification as well as testing of all raw materials supplied by these vendors for every batch. We do in\-house stability studies to make sure our products last the full shelf life and give the best results to our customers.
 



  

 Our goal is to provide our customers with nutraceutical products that promote health and wellness, and we are committed to using science\-backed ingredients and formulations to achieve this goal. We are also committed to continuous innovation and improvement and are always looking for new ways to enhance our products and processes.
 



  
 



**Role will be based at E\-279, GIDC, Nr. Rasulpura Village, II, Bol, Sanand, Gujarat 382170, India**

 The R\&D Manager will be responsible for the development and commercialisation of dry powder blend formulations within the food and nutrition category. The individual will work closely with business, regulatory, and cross\-functional teams to translate commercial briefs into technically sound, regulatory\-compliant products for everyday and sports nutrition applications.
 



  
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




 •   Work on product development briefs received from the business team and convert them into viable formulations.

description:
This role exists to protect one person's time and make sure nothing falls through the cracks. You'll be the right hand to the Operations Head — managing his calendar, capturing what happens in meetings, and making sure every internal and marketing project moves forward without him having to chase it.
 



 This is not just scheduling and note\-taking. You are the person who knows the status of everything, reminds the right people at the right time, and keeps the operation organized while leadership focuses on growth. This is a high\-trust, high\-visibility role — you'll see how a 90\-person company runs from the inside.
 



  





*This role is for someone who enjoys:* 



* Holding the full picture of what's happening across a busy leader's world
* Turning conversations into clear, owned, time\-bound follow\-ups
* Following up firmly and politely until things actually get done
* Being trusted with confidential, high\-stakes information



  





 If you're someone who's naturally organized, doesn't let things slip, and wants a front\-row seat to how a growing company operates, this role will suit you well.
 



  





**What you'll really be doing** 




  





**1\. Calendar \& Inbox Management** 



* Own and organize the Operations Head's calendar end to end — schedule, reschedule, resolve conflicts, protect focus time
* Coordinate across time zones, primarily India and US
* Manage email triage: flag what needs attention, draft routine replies, keep the inbox under control



  





**2\. Meeting Support** 



* Attend designated internal, marketing, and leadership meetings to capture minutes, decisions, and action items
* Convert discussions into clear, assigned, time\-bound follow\-ups
* Distribute notes promptly and make sure owners know what they committed to



  





**3\. Internal \& Marketing Project Coordination** 



* Keep all internal and marketing projects organized and current in the project management system
* Track status, deadlines, and blockers across active work
* Follow up with team members on tasks assigned by the Operations Head — proactively, before things slip
* Surface what's overdue or at risk before it becomes a problem



  





**4\. Follow\-Up \& Accountability** 



* Maintain a live view of every open commitment across the team
* Remind people on pending items and close the loop
* Be the system that ensures "I asked someone to do this" actually gets done



  





**Who will thrive in this role** 



* You hold many threads at once without dropping any of them
* You follow up firmly and politely — you don't let things go quiet
* You can work independently from week one with minimal supervision
* You're discreet and trustworthy with confidential business information
* You communicate clearly and confidently with US\-based leadership and partners



  





**Qualifications \& Skills** 




  





**Experience** 



* 4–5 years minimum as an Executive Assistant, Operations Coordinator, or Project Coordinator — experience within an IT services company is a must



  





**Must Have Skills** 



* Strong written and spoken English — you'll be communicating with a US\-based leadership team and US agency partners
* Highly organized, detail\-obsessed, and able to hold many threads at once
* Comfortable following up firmly and politely until things are done
* Able to work independently from week one with minimal supervision
* Discreet and trustworthy with confidential business information



  





**Tools \& Platforms** 



* Notion — documentation, SOPs, and knowledge base
* Google Calendar \& Gmail — scheduling and inbox management
* Slack — internal communication
* Fathom — meeting transcription and notes



*Experience with project management tools is required. Direct experience with this exact stack is a plus, not a dealbreaker.* 




  





**Nice to Have** 



* Prior experience supporting a founder, COO, or senior operations leader
* Exposure to a digital agency or multi\-company setup
* Familiarity with AI tools for productivity — meeting summarization, task tracking, or inbox management



  





**What this role offers** 



* A high\-trust, high\-visibility seat next to leadership
* Direct exposure to how a 90\-person company runs day\-to\-day
* Ownership over the systems that keep the operation from slipping
* Room to grow into broader operations responsibility over time

title: Lead Mechanical Engineer - Product Development
description:
Immediate Hiring \| Joining Date: 1st October 2026 (or Earlier Preferred)
 



 Location: Ahmedabad, Gujarat
 



 Employment Type: Full\-time, On\-site
 



 Company: iNSPIRE Design
 



  





  





 Please Read Before Applying
 



 We are looking for a Lead Mechanical Engineer who can join on or before 1st September 2026\.
 



 If you are serving a notice period that extends beyond this date, please apply only if your current employer is willing to provide an early release.
 



 This is an immediate requirement, and applications from candidates who can join within the required timeline will be given preference.
 



  





  





 About iNSPIRE Design
 



 iNSPIRE Design is a product development and engineering company based in Ahmedabad. We work with startups, established companies, research institutions, and healthcare professionals to develop new products from early\-stage concepts through functional prototypes and manufacturing readiness.
 



 Our projects primarily involve medical devices, electromechanical products, test fixtures, consumer products, automation systems, and custom engineering solutions. The work is highly varied and requires strong first\-principles engineering, practical problem\-solving, rapid prototyping, and close coordination with clients, vendors, and internal teams.
 



  





 The Role
 



 We are looking for a senior, hands\-on mechanical engineer who can take technical ownership of complex product development projects.
 



 This is not a role limited to CAD modelling or preparing drawings. The selected candidate will be expected to understand client requirements, develop product architectures, make engineering decisions, guide junior engineers and designers, resolve prototype failures, and lead projects through design, testing, iteration, and manufacturing handover.
 



 The person should be capable of operating independently and gradually taking ownership of the day\-to\-
 



 day engineering function within the company.
 



  





  





 Key Responsibilities
 



  





  





 Product Development and Engineering
 


* Lead mechanical product development projects from initial requirements through functional prototype and manufacturing readiness.
* Convert incomplete or evolving client requirements into clear engineering specifications and development plans.
* Develop product architecture, mechanisms, assemblies, enclosures, structural components, and electromechanical integration concepts.
* Perform engineering calculations related to loads, stresses, fits, tolerances, motion, thermal behaviour, material selection, and manufacturing feasibility.
* Identify technical risks early and develop practical methods to test and reduce those risks.
* Review existing designs critically and recommend improvements based on performance, reliability, cost, usability, and manufacturability.
* Troubleshoot prototype failures and lead structured root\-cause analysis and corrective action.



  





  





 Design and Documentation
 


* Create and review detailed 3D CAD models, assemblies, manufacturing drawings, and engineering documentation.
* Apply appropriate GD\&T, tolerance stack\-up, fits, clearances, fastener selection, and assembly considerations.
* Maintain proper revision control, design records, BOMs, technical specifications, and project documentation.
* Ensure designs are suitable for prototyping as well as eventual production.
* Conduct design reviews and approve engineering outputs before release.



  





  





 Prototyping and Testing
 


* Plan and supervise the fabrication and assembly of proof\-of\-concept and functional prototypes.
* Select suitable prototyping methods, including 3D printing, CNC machining, sheet metal fabrication, laser cutting, casting, and off\-the\-shelf component integration.
* Develop test plans, fixtures, acceptance criteria, and validation methods.
* Personally participate in prototype assembly, testing, debugging, and design iteration where required.
* Make sound engineering decisions even when complete data or ideal resources are unavailable.



  





  





 Manufacturing and Vendor Coordination
 


* Work directly with machine shops, fabricators, moulders, component suppliers, and contract manufacturers.
* Review vendor quotations, manufacturing processes, tolerances, material specifications, and technical capabilities.
* Resolve manufacturing and assembly issues without compromising critical product requirements.
* Support design for manufacturing, design for assembly, cost reduction, and production handover activities.
* Evaluate whether components should be custom\-developed, modified, or sourced as standard parts.



  





  





 Technical Leadership
 


* Guide and review the work of mechanical engineers, industrial designers, interns, and prototyping staff.
* Break larger projects into clearly defined engineering tasks and assign them effectively.
* Establish practical design standards, review processes, calculation practices, and documentation systems.
* Coach junior team members while maintaining accountability for timelines and quality.
* Raise the overall technical capability and engineering discipline of the organisation.
* Take responsibility for technical decisions rather than depending on constant direction from the founder.



  





  





 Project and Client Ownership
 


* Participate in client discussions to understand technical requirements, constraints, and priorities.
* Explain engineering decisions, risks, limitations, and trade\-offs clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Prepare realistic project plans, resource estimates, development timelines, and technical deliverables.
* Track engineering progress and proactively address delays, dependencies, and technical blockers.
* Represent the company confidently during technical reviews, vendor discussions, and client meetings.
* Balance engineering quality with commercial realities, project budgets, and delivery commitments.



  





  





 Required Qualifications
 


* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Product Design Engineering, Mechatronics, or a closely related discipline.
* Approximately 7–12 years of relevant experience in mechanical product development, machine design, medical devices, electromechanical products, automation, or a similar field.
* Strong hands\-on experience taking physical products from concept through prototyping and manufacturing.
* Advanced proficiency in SolidWorks or a comparable parametric CAD platform.
* Strong understanding of mechanical design principles, materials, manufacturing processes, tolerances, GD\&T, and assembly methods.
* Demonstrated ability to perform engineering calculations and validate designs through testing.
* Experience working directly with vendors and resolving real\-world manufacturing problems.
* Experience leading projects or mentoring junior engineers.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work independently in a fast\-moving, project\-driven environment.



  





  





 Preferred Experience
 


* Experience developing medical devices or healthcare\-related products.
* Experience with electromechanical systems involving motors, sensors, actuators, PCBs, wiring, batteries, heating systems, fluid systems, or embedded electronics.
* Familiarity with risk management, verification, validation, and regulated product development.
* Working knowledge of FEA, thermal analysis, tolerance analysis, and design optimisation.
* Experience with injection moulding, silicone moulding, sheet metal, CNC machining, and additive manufacturing.
* Experience preparing technical proposals, project plans, cost estimates, and client presentations.
* Exposure to quality systems, ISO 13485, design controls, or medical device documentation would be an advantage.



  





  





 What We Are Looking For
 



 The right candidate will be:
 


* A strong engineer first and a manager second.
* Comfortable making decisions and taking responsibility for the outcome.
* Highly practical and capable of turning concepts into working physical products.
* Willing to question assumptions and challenge technically weak approaches.
* Systematic when investigating failures and resolving engineering problems.
* Capable of balancing ideal engineering solutions with cost, timelines, available resources, and manufacturability.
* Comfortable working across multiple projects and industries.
* Able to communicate directly with clients and defend engineering decisions.
* Interested in building an engineering team and improving how product development is executed across the company.



  





  





 What This Role Is Not
 



 This is not a role for someone whose experience is limited to:
 


* Creating CAD models based on instructions provided by others.
* Managing teams without remaining technically hands\-on.
* Working only on one narrow component or process within a large organisation.
* Preparing presentations and reports without building and testing physical products.
* Waiting for complete requirements before beginning engineering work.



  





  





 Why Join iNSPIRE Design
 


* Work on diverse and technically challenging product development projects.
* Take meaningful ownership of products rather than working on isolated components.
* Work directly with founders, clients, researchers, doctors, startups, and manufacturing partners.
* Build prototypes and see designs progress from initial concepts to real physical products.
* Play a central role in developing the company’s engineering function.
* Opportunity to grow into broader engineering and technical leadership responsibilities as the organisation expands.



  





  





 Application Requirements
 



 Candidates should submit:
 


* An updated resume.
* A brief portfolio or examples of products, mechanisms, machines, or assemblies they have personally developed.
* A clear description of their individual contribution to each project.
* Details of one significant prototype or product failure they diagnosed and resolved.
* Current location, notice period, and availability for an on\-site role in Ahmedabad.

title: Specification Manager - Luxury Interiors & Projects
description:
**JSB is looking for someone who sells a premium material to architects, designers, developers and discerning homeowners — and wants a better one to sell them.** 




  





**About** 




  





 Founded in Kishangarh in 1993, JSB is one of India's largest importers and processors of natural marble. We buy blocks directly at the quarry across more than 40 countries, process them at our own facility, and hold over 400 colours in live inventory — Statuario, Calacatta, Brazilian quartzite, onyx, travertine and exotic stones.
 



  





 Architects, designers, developers and homeowners travel from across India to our Kishangarh Experience Centre to select their slabs personally.
 



  





 We deal in imported marble only. No Indian marble. No granite.
 



  





**The role** 




  





 We are opening Ahmedabad, and we are looking for the person who will own Gujarat.
 



  





 This is specification work. There is no dealer network to appoint and no monthly order book to service. Your job is to make JSB the material that gets specified — the name reached for when a project calls for something extraordinary underfoot.
 



  





 Your clientele is the full top end of the market:
 



  





 • Architects and design studios
 



 • Interior designers and turnkey interior firms
 



 • Luxury residential and hospitality developers
 



 • Project management consultants on premium projects
 



 • HNI homeowners building or renovating privately
 



  





 You will get JSB specified at design stage, hold the relationship through material selection, and bring your client to Kishangarh to choose their stone with their own eyes.
 



  





**What you will do** 




  





 • Build a specification map of Gujarat's top end — studio by studio, developer by developer, principal by principal — starting in Ahmedabad and extending through Gandhinagar, Vadodara, Surat and Rajkot
 



 • Get JSB specified at design stage on luxury residences, villas and farmhouses, high\-end apartment projects, hospitality, premium retail and flagship corporate interiors
 



 • Work both sides of a project: the design studio that specifies the material, and the developer, PMC or homeowner who signs for it
 



 • Run material presentations, place samples, and establish JSB inside design studio material libraries
 



 • Bring clients to Kishangarh. Marble is chosen with the eye. Your project becomes real when your client is standing in our slab yard, looking at the block.
 



 • Guide clients through selection: colour, veining, book\-matching, finish, and how a slab will read in the space it is going into
 



 • Own the project from selection through to delivery coordination with HQ
 



 • Maintain a disciplined pipeline: project, area in sq ft, stage, decision maker
 



  





**Who we are looking for** 




  





 You are most likely doing something close to this today at a luxury interiors or premium surfaces brand — Kohler, TOTO, Duravit, Grohe, Hansgrohe, Roca, Villeroy \& Boch, Artize, Cosentino, Caesarstone, Laminam, Häfele, Hettich, Asian Paints Beautiful Homes, Saint\-Gobain, Greenlam, or a premium lighting or decorative finishes brand.
 



  





 What matters more than the logo on your card:
 



  





 • 6 to 12 years selling a premium or luxury interior product into design studios and high\-end projects, with Ahmedabad and Gujarat as your working territory
 



 • A live relationship map you personally own — architects, interior designers, luxury developers, PMCs and HNI clients
 



 • You have sold a premium material against a cheaper alternative and won on design and value, not on discount
 



 • You can hold your own in a design conversation. You understand that when an architect chooses a material, they are choosing how a room will feel — and you can talk about it that way.
 



 • You can also hold your own in a commercial conversation with a developer or PMC on rate, quantity and delivery
 



 • You are comfortable in premium rooms: design studios, owner\-side site meetings, HNI drawing rooms
 



 • Fluent in Gujarati, Hindi and English
 



 • Graduate. A B.Arch or interior design background is a genuine advantage. MBA optional.
 



  





**Straight talk before you apply** 




  





 We would rather lose you at the advert than at month three.
 



  





 • There is no regional office or showroom in Ahmedabad. You work from the field, out of design studios and client sites. Telecalling, back office, inventory and processing all sit at Kishangarh HQ.
 



 • There is no dedicated company vehicle. Travel is reimbursed against actuals.
 



 • Clients buy by seeing the slab. A meaningful part of your performance is how many qualified clients you bring to Kishangarh.
 



 • The first 90 days are field\-first. Personal meetings, personally done.
 



 • Compensation is part fixed and part performance. The variable is uncapped and tiered by project value band, so specifying higher\-value stone pays you materially more.
 



  





 If you want a showroom to sit in and a dealer network to service, this is not your role. If you want to build a territory in your own name, for a house that buys its own blocks at the quarry and processes them itself, it is.
 



  





**What we offer** 




  





 • Fixed salary of 5\-6 LPA, based on experience and the strength of your existing network
 



 • Uncapped tiered incentive on project value, paid above threshold
 



 • Travel reimbursed at actuals, plus mobile allowance
 



 • A material with genuine range. Over 400 colours in live inventory, so you are rarely the one saying no.
 



 • Direct access to principal\-level decision making. We own the buying, the inventory and the processing, so you are never waiting on a third party to quote.
 



  





**To apply** 




  





 Email keshav.bangur@jsbstonex.com with the subject line: Specification Manager – Ahmedabad – \[Your Name]
 



  





 Answer these three questions in your email. Applications that do not answer them are not reviewed.
 



  





 1\. Name three architecture, design or developer clients in Ahmedabad you have personally worked with, and the person you deal with at each.
 



 2\. What is the largest single project you have personally specified? Project type and approximate area or value.
 



 3\. Your current fixed CTC and notice period.
 



  





 Applications are reviewed personally. If you are shortlisted, you will hear from us within five working days.

title: Sr. Firmware Engineer / Firmware Lead
description:
**About Oizom** 


 Oizom builds environmental monitoring hardware and software — air quality, noise, vibration, and gas\-sensing products deployed in the field across multiple markets. Our product line spans Polludrone (ambient air quality), Sonicbot (Class 1 noise monitoring), Seismibot (ground vibration), OGS (electrochemical gas sensing), Sensorbox, and AirOwl (our open\-source ESP32\-based air quality monitor). Our R\&D team spans Industrial Design, Design Engineering, Embedded Hardware, and Embedded Firmware.
 



**Role Summary** 


 We're hiring a Senior Firmware Engineer to lead our embedded firmware team. This is a hybrid role: roughly half hands\-on architecture and development across our MCU and embedded\-Linux product lines, and half technical leadership — mentoring junior engineers, setting coding and review standards, and owning firmware delivery across multiple concurrent product programs.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 

**Technical leadership** 



* Lead and mentor a team of 3–5 junior/mid firmware engineers — code reviews, design reviews, and hands\-on pairing
* Own firmware architecture decisions across product lines and make the build\-vs\-buy, framework, and platform calls
* Set and enforce firmware coding standards, version control practices, and release processes
* Plan and track firmware workstreams against product timelines; report status to the Head of R\&D



**Hands\-on development** 



* Develop and maintain firmware for ESP32/ESP32\-S3\-based products (sensor readout, connectivity, power management)
* Develop and maintain firmware for STM32\-based products (bare\-metal or RTOS, sensor interfacing, real\-time measurement paths)
* Build and maintain Python\-based firmware/application software for Raspberry Pi CM4\-based products (config\-driven sensor drivers, Modbus/serial interfacing, BLE, edge processing)
* Containerize and deploy services using Docker (on\-device services and supporting cloud/data pipelines)
* Implement and debug communication protocols: I2C, SPI, UART, RS\-485/Modbus RTU, SDI\-12, MQTT, BLE
* Work closely with Embedded Hardware and Design Engineering on bring\-up, debugging, and DFM feedback loops


**Required Skills \& Experience** 
* 6–9 years of professional embedded firmware development experience, including at least 1–2 years in a lead or mentoring capacity
* Strong C/C\+\+ firmware development on
 
**ESP32** 

 (Arduino or ESP\-IDF) and
 
**STM32** 

 (bare\-metal or an RTOS such as FreeRTOS)
* Strong
 
**Python 3** 

 for embedded Linux application/firmware work on
 
**Raspberry Pi CM4** 

 or similar SBCs
* Practical experience with
 
**Docker** 

 — containerizing device\-side services and/or supporting data pipelines
* Solid grasp of embedded communication protocols: I2C, SPI, UART, and at least one of RS\-485/Modbus RTU, SDI\-12, or MQTT
* Hands\-on experience with wireless/cellular connectivity:
 
**Quectel 4G/LTE modules** 

 (AT command interfacing),
 
**LoRa** 

 ,
 
**WiFi** 

 , and
 
**BLE** 

 stacks
* Comfortable with hardware\-level debugging: JTAG/SWD, logic analyzers, oscilloscopes, reading schematics and datasheets
* Git\-based version control and structured code review practices
* Demonstrated ability to lead a small team — planning work, unblocking others, and maintaining code quality without micromanaging


**Nice to Have** 
* Experience with sensor\-heavy or field\-deployed IoT products (environmental, industrial, or similar harsh\-environment hardware)
* Experience with cellular modules (e.g., Telit/Quectel LTE) and connectivity recovery/watchdog design
* Familiarity with a self\-hosted data stack (e.g., MQTT broker, Telegraf/InfluxDB/Grafana) for device telemetry
* Exposure to analog front\-end or electrochemical/gas\-sensing signal chains
* Experience with BLE peripheral/central firmware
* Prior experience in a startup or small\-team R\&D environment where you owned outcomes end\-to\-end

title: Supply Chain Planning Lead – T-FIT
description:
Zotefoams plc is a global leader in advanced cellular materials, trusted by some of the world’s most recognised brands to deliver high‑performance solutions.
   

  

 We design and manufacture lightweight, high‑quality foam products that support innovation across sectors including sports and leisure, aviation, automotive, medical and industrial applications. Alongside our core materials business, we develop and commercialise patented technologies and deliver specialist insulation systems for complex, high‑value environments.
   

  

 This is an exciting time to join Zotefoams. We are growing internationally, investing in our people, technology and capabilities, and seeing increasing demand for our products across global markets. Our work sits at the heart of innovation, helping customers push boundaries in performance, sustainability and design.
   

  

 We offer the chance to be part of a collaborative, forward‑thinking organisation where your ideas are valued, your development is supported, and your contribution has real impact on a global scale.
   

  

**About the Role\~**
 This is a key role responsible for coordinating demand, supply, inventory and production planning across our internal and external supply chain.
   

  

 You will translate sales forecasts and customer requirements into clear, achievable supply plans, working closely with production, procurement, logistics and commercial teams. You will help improve planning discipline, provide greater visibility of risks and support the business in meeting its customer service, revenue and inventory objectives.
   

  

 This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced planning professional who enjoys bringing structure to a growing business, working across multiple functions and using data to support effective decisions.

* Coordinating regular demand and supply reviews, ensuring assumptions, constraints, risks and actions are clearly captured.
* Translating sales forecasts and customer requirements into practical supply and production plans.
* Working closely with production sites, procurement, logistics and commercial teams to align supply with demand.
* Maintaining accurate planning data, assumptions and key system inputs.
* Monitoring inventory and product availability, identifying risks relating to customer service, excess stock and working capital.
* Identifying capacity constraints, material risks and planning gaps that could affect monthly supply or revenue.
* Producing clear planning reports and updates covering demand, supply, inventory, service and forecast accuracy.
* Improving data quality, planning discipline and adherence to agreed processes.
* Escalating risks and trade\-offs clearly, supported by practical recommendations.
* Contributing to the continuous improvement of planning processes, reporting and ways of working.


**What you'll need\~**
* At least five years’ experience within supply chain planning, demand planning, production planning, manufacturing, logistics or a related role.
* A good understanding of demand, supply, inventory or production planning principles.
* Strong analytical skills and confidence working with data, spreadsheets, enterprise resource planning systems and planning reports.
* The ability to turn commercial forecasts and customer requirements into realistic operational plans.
* Clear communication skills and the confidence to work with stakeholders across commercial, manufacturing, procurement and logistics teams.
* Strong organisation and attention to detail, with the ability to manage changing priorities.
* The confidence to challenge assumptions constructively, identify risks and recommend appropriate action.
* This role involves regular communication with stakeholders across the UK, Europe, USA and Asia, therefore strong spoken and written English is essential.


**It would be beneficial if you also have**
* A degree or professional qualification in supply chain, business, engineering or a related subject.
* Experience with sales and operations planning, sales and operations execution, material requirements planning or enterprise resource planning processes.
* Experience working within an international or multi\-site manufacturing business.


**Why Join Us?**
 Zotefoams is growing fast, investing globally and winning in new markets. This is a chance to be part of a business where things are moving, decisions are made quickly, and your work has real impact.
   

  

 You won’t be a small cog here. You’ll have the space to take ownership, contribute ideas and see them through. We back our people to develop, step up and build long term careers, supported by a team that works together and delivers.
   

  

**Our Values**
**Courage** 
 – We challenge, act and push for better.
   

  

**Impact** 
 – We focus on what matters and deliver results.
   

  

**Respect** 
 – We value different perspectives and work as one team.
   

  

 Zotefoams is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive.
   

  

 Zotefoams is a world leader in cellular material technology. Using a unique manufacturing process with environmentally friendly nitrogen expansion, Zotefoams produces lightweight foams in Croydon, UK and Kentucky, USA for diverse markets worldwide. These markets include sports and leisure, storage and protection, automotive, aviation and space, railway, healthcare, building, marine and the military.
