description:
**Project Manager Teacher Capacity Building Program · Sanand, Ahmedabad** 




  





**About Freadom Edu** 




  





 Freadom Edu is an Indo\-Finnish education initiative working at the intersection of foundational literacy, English language learning, and Finnish pedagogy. We partner with governments, schools, and CSR funders to deliver measurable learning outcomes for children in underserved communities across India. Our Teacher Capacity Building Program strengthens the instructional quality and professional confidence of government primary school teachers across Grades 1–5\.
 



  





**About the Role** 




  





 We are hiring a Project Manager to anchor the on\-ground implementation of our Teacher Capacity Building Program in Sanand taluka. This is a high\-ownership, field\-heavy role requiring someone equally comfortable in government offices and school classrooms.
 



  





 You will be responsible for end\-to\-end operational execution — from government coordination and school onboarding to training logistics, attendance tracking, and impact documentation — across approximately:
 



  





 This is a time\-bound, single\-cohort program. We are looking for someone who thrives under structured timelines and can keep a complex, multi\-stakeholder program on track with minimal hand\-holding.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





 Government Liaison \& School Coordination
 







 ● Coordinate with the District Education Officer (DEO) and Block Education Officers (BEO) to obtain school and teacher lists and secure institutional support
 



 ● Serve as the primary point of contact between Freadom Edu and local government education authorities ● Facilitate school onboarding, teacher orientation logistics, and any required permissions or communications at school and cluster level
 



  





**Program Execution** 




 ● Manage end\-to\-end scheduling and logistics for all training sessions — orientation, online modules, reflective sessions, and the wrap\-up/certification session
 



 ● Coordinate with trainers (Finnish and Indian faculty) to ensure sessions are delivered on time and to brief ● Monitor teacher attendance and engagement across all sessions; track against program targets and flag gaps early
 



 ● Ensure all training materials, devices, and support resources reach schools on schedule
 



  





**Data Collection \& Documentation** 




  





 ● Oversee baseline and endline data collection across the cohort using programme assessment tools
 



 ● Maintain accurate, up\-to\-date records of teacher participation, school coverage, and session completion ● Coordinate with the eGrader / platform team to track digital engagement and follow up on low\-engagement schools
 



 ● Compile field observations, photographs, and teacher feedback for reporting purposes
 



  





**Stakeholder Communication** 




 ● Prepare fortnightly progress updates for the Freadom Edu program lead
 



 ● Liaise with CSR partners as required during reporting periods; ensure data is ready for quarterly reports
 



 ● Build and maintain relationships with school heads and cluster resource coordinators (CRCs) to drive sustained teacher participation
 



  





**Field Presence \& Community Engagement** 




 ● Conduct regular school visits to monitor program fidelity, surface implementation challenges early, and document classroom practice changes
 



 ● Facilitate Teacher Learning Community (TLC) sessions and peer\-sharing circles as part of the program model
 



 ● Identify and escalate risks — attendance drop\-off, school\-access issues, community resistance — with proposed mitigations
 



  





**Who We're Looking For Essential** 




  





 ● 3–6 years of experience in education program management, CSR implementation, or development sector field roles
 



 ● Prior experience working with government schools and education department officials in Gujarat (or comparable state)
 



 ● Fluent in Gujarati and Hindi; working proficiency in English
 



 ● Strong organisational and documentation skills — comfortable managing spreadsheets, attendance trackers, and field reports simultaneously
 



 ● Demonstrated ability to work independently in the field with remote line management
 



 ● Willingness to travel extensively within Sanand taluka and to Ahmedabad as needed
 



  





**Preferred** 




  





 ● Background in teacher training, school education programs, or foundational literacy / numeracy work
 



 ● Experience with monitoring and evaluation, assessment data collection, or learning outcome tracking
 



 ● Familiarity with Gujarat's government school ecosystem — DEO/BEO structures, CRC/BRC frameworks, and state curriculum
 



 ● Exposure to CSR\-funded program environments with funder reporting requirements
 



 ● Experience using digital tools for program tracking 
 



  





**Compensation** 




  





 Competitive, commensurate with experience and sector norms. 
 



  





**How to Apply** 




  





 Apply using the form below. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. We encourage early submissions.

 Applications without a resume/CV upload will not be considered.

Our vision is to create world\-class airports that serve as gateways to regional development and global connectivity, positioning Adani Airports as a leader in the aviation sector with a focus on sustainable growth and community impact.
   

  

**Job Purpose:** 
 Lead \- Projects IT will be responsible for managing and overseeing the successful installation, testing and commissioning of IT systems and technologies across all construction projects. This includes overseeing IT infrastructure deployments, construction project management systems, and ensuring the integration of advanced technology solutions to support efficient airport construction processes. The role requires collaboration with internal teams, external contractors, and stakeholders to ensure IT systems are aligned with construction objectives, safety regulations, and compliance standards.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**IT Project Management:**
* Lead the planning, execution, and delivery of IT projects focused on construction, such as Building Information Modeling (BIM) integration, project management software (e.g., SAP or Oracle), and real\-time data analytics tools.
* Coordinate the implementation of IT systems for construction project monitoring, scheduling, resource allocation, and cost tracking.
* Develop and manage detailed project plans, ensuring alignment with construction timelines, safety standards, and airport regulations.


**Construction IT Systems**
* Ensure that technology solutions, such as BIM, are effectively integrated with airport construction activities to enhance project collaboration and improve efficiency.
* Oversee the deployment of IT systems that support digital twins, GIS mapping, construction automation tools, data centers, network architecture, communication systems and compliance with aviation and construction standards.
* Manage the installation of network infrastructure, including fiber optics, IoT sensors, and wireless systems to support real\-time project tracking and remote monitoring.
* Collaborate with airport operations to provide operational support for critical 24/7 airport functions related to construction projects.


**Stakeholder Engagement**
* Collaborate with the construction and IT teams, contractors, suppliers, and regulatory bodies to deliver IT projects that support the airport's construction activities.
* Act as a liaison between the IT department and construction stakeholders to ensure technology meets project requirements and adheres to regulatory compliance.


**Risk Management \& Compliance**
* Identify potential IT risks related to construction projects and develop mitigation strategies.
* Ensure that all IT systems used in construction meet industry standards and aviation regulations (e.g., ICAO, IATA) and comply with cybersecurity and data protection protocols.
* Address health and safety concerns by ensuring that IT systems are designed to support safe construction practices.


**Budget And Financial Oversight**
* Oversee the IT project budget specific to construction, ensuring cost\-effective use of resources and technology investments.
* Provide financial forecasts and reports on project IT expenditures to senior management.


**Vendor And Contract Management**
* Negotiate and manage relationships with IT vendors, ensuring the delivery of quality services and adherence to contractual obligations.
* Oversee the procurement of IT systems and services, ensuring alignment with the airport's long\-term technology roadmap.


**Digital Mindset**
* Drive the adoption of innovative digital technologies like BIM, IoT, and data analytics to enhance efficiency in construction projects.
* Stay updated with emerging construction technologies to improve efficiency and ensure airport infrastructure is built using advanced IT solutions.


**Team Leadership And Development**
* Lead and mentor team members by providing constructive feedback, helping them develop their technical and project management skills.
* Develop a pipeline of talent within the team to ensure continuity in IT projects.
* Actively engage the team by promoting a positive work culture and recognizing individual and collective achievements.


**Key Stakeholders \- Internal**
* Head \- Construction
* Project Head
* IT Department Head
* Project Management Team
* IT Infrastructure Team
* Construction Engineers
* Techno Commercial \& Contracts Department
* Compliance \& Regulatory Department
* Finance and Budgeting Team


**Key Stakeholders \- External**
* Civil Aviation Authority
* Technology Vendors and Service Providers
* External Contractors and Subcontractors
* Government Regulatory Bodies
* IT Consultants
* Health and Safety Agencies
* External Auditors and Inspectors
* BCAS/DGCA


**Qualifications**
**Educational Qualifications:**
* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology/Electronics/Instrumentation or a related field.
* A Master’s degree in IT or Project Management, or relevant certifications (PMP, PRINCE2\) is preferred.


**Work Experience**
* 12\+ years of experience in IT project management, with specific experience in managing IT systems for large\-scale infrastructure or construction projects with minimum 5 years experience in airports.

title: Founder's office
description:
**Location:** 

 Ahmedabad (hybrid)
 
**Reports to:** 

 Founders
 
**Type:** 

 Full\-time
 



**About the role** 


 We're looking for someone to sit close to the founders and help make the agency run better. Someone who can look at how we deliver work for clients, spot where time and money leak, and fix it. You'll start on operations and process, move into client\-facing work within 6 months, and be positioned to lead ops for the agency in 2–3 years.
 





 This is a build\-and\-own role. You'll get access to how the business actually runs and be expected to bring structure to it, not just watch.
 



**What you'll actually do** 

**First 6 months \- operations and systems** 



* Map how work currently moves through the agency: brief → proposal → kickoff → delivery → review → renewal. Find where it breaks.
* Build and maintain SOPs for recurring workflows (SEO/AEO retainers, website redesigns, content production, campaign reporting)
* Track project timelines and deliverables across accounts, flag slippage before clients do
* Work with founders on proposal scoping and pricing \- sit in on the conversations, not just format the docs
* Own internal reporting: what's on time, what's at risk, what's profitable
* Sit in on client calls to learn the accounts, the people, and how we sell and service



**6 months onward \- client\-facing** 



* Take direct ownership of select client relationships (starting smaller/lower\-risk accounts, scaling up)
* Run status calls, handle day\-to\-day client communication, manage scope conversations
* Be the point of escalation before it needs to reach a founder



**2–3 years \- ops leadership** 



* Own agency operations end to end: resourcing, delivery quality, tooling, process
* Build and manage a small ops/PM function as the agency scales
* Be a founder\-level thinking partner on how the business is structured and run


**What we need from you** 
* 1–2 years of experience in agency operations, client servicing, or project management \- ideally at a marketing, design, or digital agency
* You understand what "billable," "scope creep," and "retainer" mean in your sleep
* Sharp with tools \- you should already be using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, etc.) in your daily work, not as a novelty but because it makes you faster. We're an AI\-native shop; if you're not already working this way, this isn't the right fit
* Comfortable being in rooms with founders and clients and holding your own
* A working sense of tech and marketing \- you don't need to write code or run ad campaigns yourself, but you should understand what SEO, performance marketing, brand identity, and website work actually involve, enough to spot bad scoping or a missed handoff
* Sharp with spreadsheets, docs, and basic reporting \- you'll be building the systems, not waiting for someone to hand them to you
* Low ego about the work. Early on this role involves a lot of unglamorous process\-building before it becomes client\-facing


**Nice to have, not required** 
* Prior experience at a boutique or small agency (where you wear multiple hats by necessity)
* Exposure to B2B SaaS or D2C client environments
* Some hands\-on experience with SEO/AEO, content, or performance marketing basics


**Why this role** 


 Most ops or associate roles at agencies keep you in a lane. This one doesn't \- you're in the room for strategy, scoping, and delivery from day one, and the path to owning a P\&L\-relevant function is explicit, not vague. If you want to eventually run something rather than support something, this is built for that.

title: Software Engineering Manager — Funded Development
description:
**Department:** 
 Engineering
   

  

**Location:** 
 Ahmedabad/GiftCity
   

  

**Description**
 We are looking for a hands\-on Software Engineering Manager to lead the Funded Development (Services / NRR) POD — the cross\-functional team accountable for delivering customer\-funded enhancements and bespoke solutions on top of our trading platform. The role sits at the intersection of engineering delivery and commercial commitment and is measured on how predictably the POD ships committed customer work on time, at the quality bar our clients expect, across multiple concurrent engagements.
   

  

 This is a working manager role: you are expected to stay close to the code — reviewing designs, code and stepping in on the hardest problems — while primarily driving delivery for the POD. The POD's core surface is Order Routing and the Market Data ecosystem, with regular contributions into Risk, FIX services, trading UI enhancements and other backend systems as customer commitments require.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Delivery \& stakeholder ownership — Own end\-to\-end delivery of customer\-funded projects across multiple concurrent engagements. Run the daily cadence (standups, sprint reviews, hand\-offs) and act as the primary engineering point of contact for Product and Project Management on requirements, estimation, capacity planning, project tracking, CR workflows, and risk. Surface schedule and scope of risk early with credible mitigations, and provide honest, timely status to Client Services, Sales, Platform, Release Engineering, and senior leadership.
* Hands\-on technical leadership \& design — Stay close to one or more components across the TT platform (Order Routing, Market Data, Risk, FIX services, trading UI). Author tech design documents for non\-trivial customer\-funded features and review designs produced by the team — ensuring correctness, performance, blast radius on shared components, rollout / rollback, observability, and long\-term supportability. Set the quality bar through architecture, design, and code reviews in modern C\+\+, and be the escalation\-of\-last\-resort on hard issues.
* Cross\-component versatility \& engineering excellence — Deliver across a broad surface — Order Routing, Market Data, Risk, FIX services, and trading UI enhancements — as customer commitments evolve. Drive engineering best practices across the POD: modern C\+\+ standards, multithreading and concurrency correctness, performance tuning, automated testing, and CI hygiene. Treat customer\-funded work as first\-class product code, not throwaway one\-offs, and build a POD that can flex across components without becoming shallow on any of them.
* AI\-assisted engineering — Champion the adoption of AI coding assistants and agentic tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Copilot, and internal AI tooling) across the POD to accelerate delivery, code review, test authoring, design exploration, and production diagnostics. Set the bar for responsible use — quality, security, IP protection, and human accountability for shipped code — and share patterns that work back into the wider engineering org.
* SE \+ SQE leadership — Lead a cross\-functional POD of Software Engineers and Software Quality Engineers. Foster a shared ownership model where quality is designed in, not bolted on, and where SQEs are equal partners in scoping, automation, and release readiness.
* People management \& culture — Line\-manage the POD: 1:1s, feedback, growth plans, hiring, and calibration. Build a fair, sustainable delivery culture that can absorb context switching and shifting priorities without burning people out or letting quality slip.


**Skills, Knowledge And Expertise**
**Essential Skills \& Experience**
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience), with 10 to 12 years of software engineering experience and 2\+ years managing a mid\-sized engineering team, including line management of engineers.
* Expert\-level hands\-on proficiency in modern C\+\+ (C\+\+11 through C\+\+20\) — able to review and write production\-grade code, and to lead deep technical discussions on architecture, multithreading, concurrency, and performance.
* Deep experience delivering software for electronic trading, capital markets, or other high\-performance, mission\-critical, low\-latency systems, with strong working knowledge of trading\-system fundamentals: order lifecycle, exchange gateways, FIX / exchange protocols, market data, price generation, and risk checks.
* Proven track record delivering complex, customer\-committed software projects in an Agile environment — working closely with Product and Project Management on estimation, planning, and CR workflows — and managing multiple concurrent engagements with changing priorities, aggressive timelines, and frequent context switching, while still meeting commitments.
* Hands\-on experience using AI coding assistants and/or agentic developer tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor, or equivalents) in real delivery — with a clear point of view on where they add leverage, where they don't, and how to keep quality, security, and IP under control.
* Proficient with Linux, production diagnostics, and debugging / profiling tools (GDB, Address Sanitizer, perf, and similar).
* Demonstrated success as a people manager — growing engineers and SQEs, hiring, calibrating, and handling difficult conversations — with excellent communication and stakeholder\-management skills across engineering, Product, Project Management, Client Services, and customers.


**Desirable Skills \& Experience**
* Prior experience leading customer\-funded, professional services, or bespoke\-delivery engineering teams in a financial\-technology context, ideally on a major OMS/EMS/trading platform with exposure to Order Routing, Market Data, Risk, FIX services, or trading UI.
* Familiarity with major exchange connectivity stacks (CME, ICE, Eurex, LSE, NSE, etc.) and with vendor certification / conformance testing, plus experience with formal CR / change\-management workflows in a regulated financial environment (Jira / Confluence for delivery tracking and design documentation).
* Working knowledge of Python for tooling, automation, and test scaffolding; familiarity with CI/CD, DevOps practices, containerisation, and cloud technologies as applied to trading\-system delivery; background in kernel\-bypass / low\-latency networking (Solarflare, Onload) or lock\-free data structures.
* Track record of driving measurable productivity gains through AI adoption in an engineering team — e.g., accelerating design, code generation, code review, test coverage, or production triage — including establishing guardrails, prompts/skills libraries, and adoption metrics.


**Benefits**
***Competitive Benefits \& Perks in India***
*We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well\-being, growth, and work\-life balance.*
* Health \& Financial Security:
+ Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage

* Time Off \& Flexibility:
+ Enjoy the best of both worlds: the energy and collaboration of in\-person work, combined with the convenience and focus of remote days. This is a hybrid position requiring three days of in\-office collaboration per week, with the flexibility to work remotely for the remaining two days. Our hybrid model is designed to balance individual flexibility with the benefits of in\-person collaboration, enhanced team cohesion, spontaneous innovation, hands\-on mentorship opportunities and strengthens our company culture.
+ 21 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) per year, with the option to roll over unused days.
+ One dedicated day per year for volunteering.
+ Two professional development days per year to allow uninterrupted professional development.
+ An additional PTO day is added during milestone anniversary years.
+ Robust paid holiday schedule with early dismissal.
+ Generous parental leave for all parents (including adoptive parents).

* Work\-Life Support \& Resources:
+ Budget for tech accessories, including monitors, headphones, keyboards, and other office equipment.
+ Milestone anniversary bonuses.

* Wellness \& Lifestyle Perks:
+ Subsidy contributions toward gym memberships and health/wellness initiatives.

* Our Culture:
+ Forward\-thinking, culture\-based organization with collaborative teams that promote diversity and inclusion.

title: Assistant General Manager, Manufacturing
description:
**Key Responsibilities**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
* Technical Leadership \& Process Optimization
* Upstream Strategy: Lead the design, optimization, and troubleshooting of Solid\-Phase Peptide Synthesis (SPPS) protocols, including difficult sequences and modification chemistry.
* Downstream Scaling: Direct the scaling up of Preparative HPLC and RP\-HPLC purification methods from analytical to pilot/production scale.
* Troubleshooting: Serve as the subject matter expert (SME) to resolve complex synthesis failures, poor solubility issues, and challenging impurity profiles.
* Tech Transfer: Oversee the seamless transfer of peptide processes from the R\&D stage to validation and commercial production batches.
* Operations \& Team Management
* Resource Allocation: Manage a team 22 members of engineers/scientists, assigning daily synthesis, purification, and lyophilization tasks.

* Compliance Lead: Ensure the laboratory strictly adheres to GLP/GMP guidelines, data integrity standards, and safety regulations.

* Education: B.Tech / M.Tech in Biotechnology or Chemical Engineering OR M.Sc. / Ph.D. in Organic, Analytical, or Biochemistry.

* Technical Mastery: Deep, provable expertise spanning both upstream chain\-building (cleavage, coupling) and downstream isolation (salt\-exchange, TFF, freeze\-drying).

Working alongside scientists \& local Leadership, you will play a critical role in driving project success, fostering alignment across all Scientific disciplines and Topia Executives.
 



 If you are a skilled Project Manager with industry experience and a passion for drug Discovery Operations in a Tech\-driven organisation, this role offers the opportunity for impact and growth.

* Manage multiple Drug Discovery \& Repurposing Programs simultaneously from target selection to Program delivery/partnering

* Demonstrated experience in early small molecule Discovery (Hit Identification through Lead Optimisation and Candidate Profiling)

* Strong understanding of Drug Discovery workflows and decision\-making process, previous experience to TechBio ways of working is a plus

* Driven by challenges to manage multiple projects in a dynamic deadline\-driven environment

* Familiarity with project management tools and scientific data systems

 **healthcare/dental benefits** 
 , performance\-based bonuses and equity options

* Professional development and involvement in high impact projects.

title: APM-Interiors
description:
**Asst. Project Manager \- Corporate Interiors**
**JLL Project \& Development Services (PDS) \| Gujarat, India**
**About JLL**
 Jones Lang LaSalle (JLL) is a leading professional services firm that specializes in real estate and investment management. Our Project \& Development Services (PDS) team delivers comprehensive project and program management services across diverse industries and geographies.
   

  

**Position Overview**
 We are seeking an experienced Project Manager to lead corporate interior projects across Gujarat. This role requires a strategic thinker with strong execution capabilities who can manage end\-to\-end project delivery while maintaining the highest standards of quality, cost control, and client satisfaction.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Project Planning \& Execution**
 The Project Manager will oversee all phases of corporate interior projects from initiation through closeout. You will develop comprehensive project plans, establish timelines and milestones, coordinate design development with architects and consultants, and ensure alignment with client objectives and brand standards. Managing project scope, schedule, budget, and quality parameters while anticipating and mitigating risks will be central to your role.
   

  

**Stakeholder Management**
 Serving as the primary point of contact for clients, you will build and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders including client representatives, design consultants, contractors, vendors, and internal JLL teams. You will conduct regular progress meetings, provide transparent communication on project status, and manage expectations effectively throughout the project lifecycle.
   

  

**Financial \& Contract Management**
 You will be responsible for preparing detailed cost estimates and budget forecasts, monitoring project expenditures and cash flows, reviewing and approving contractor invoices and change orders, and ensuring projects are delivered within approved budgets. Administering contracts and ensuring compliance with terms and conditions will be essential aspects of this role.
   

  

**Quality \& Compliance**
 Ensuring that all work meets JLL quality standards and client specifications is paramount. You will conduct regular site inspections and quality audits, verify compliance with building codes, safety regulations, and statutory requirements, coordinate testing and commissioning activities, and manage the punch list and defect rectification process.
   

  

**Team Leadership**
 You will lead project teams including consultants, contractors, and JLL staff members. Building collaborative working relationships, providing clear direction and guidance, monitoring team performance, and fostering a culture of excellence and accountability will be key leadership responsibilities.
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
**Education \& Experience**
 Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, Interior Design, or Construction Management is required. A minimum of 8\-12 years of experience in project management with specific focus on corporate interiors, office fit\-outs, or commercial projects is essential. Proven track record of successfully delivering multiple projects simultaneously in the Gujarat region is highly preferred.
   

  

**Technical Competencies**
 Strong knowledge of interior construction methodologies, materials, and finishes is required. Proficiency in project management tools such as MS Project, Primavera, or equivalent software, along with advanced skills in MS Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word) is expected. Thorough understanding of building codes, safety regulations, and quality standards applicable to commercial interiors is necessary. Familiarity with MEP systems coordination and integration within interior spaces is valued.
   

  

**Professional Skills**
 Excellent communication and presentation abilities in English and Hindi (Gujarati is advantageous) are required. Strong negotiation and conflict resolution capabilities, along with exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail, are essential. Financial acumen with experience in budgeting, cost control, and forecasting is necessary. Client\-focused mindset with commitment to service excellence is fundamental to success in this role.
   

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
 PMP or equivalent project management certification demonstrates professional commitment. Experience working with multinational corporations or large\-scale corporate clients is valuable. Knowledge of sustainable building practices and LEED/IGBC certification processes is beneficial. Exposure to design\-build or integrated project delivery methods is advantageous.
   

  

**What We Offer**
 Opportunity to work with leading multinational and domestic corporate clients on prestigious interior projects. Collaborative work environment with experienced professionals committed to excellence. Professional development opportunities including training programs and certifications. Competitive compensation package commensurate with experience and qualifications. Exposure to diverse project types across various industry sectors.
   

  

**Location**
 Gujarat (Ahmedabad/Gandhinagar preferred, with willingness to travel across Gujarat as needed)
   

  

**JLL is an Equal Opportunity Employer**
 We are committed to creating an inclusive work environment that reflects the diversity of our clients and communities. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of gender, race, religion, age, disability, or other protected characteristics.
   

  

 To apply, please submit your resume and cover letter through JLL's career portal or contact your local HR representative for application procedures.

title: Senior Project Lead-Interiors
description:
**Senior Project Lead \- Corporate Interiors**
**JLL Project \& Development Services (PDS) \| Gujarat, India**
**About JLL**
 Jones Lang LaSalle (JLL) is a leading professional services firm specializing in real estate and investment management. Our Project \& Development Services (PDS) team delivers end\-to\-end project and program management solutions, helping clients transform their workspace visions into reality through excellence in execution.
   

  

**Position Overview**
 We are seeking a Senior Project Lead to drive our corporate interiors portfolio across Gujarat. This strategic leadership role requires an accomplished professional who can manage high\-value projects, mentor project teams, build client relationships, and contribute to business growth. The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise with strong commercial acumen and leadership capabilities.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategic Project Leadership**
 You will lead and oversee multiple high\-value corporate interior projects simultaneously, ranging from ₹5 crores to ₹50\+ crores in value. Developing comprehensive project strategies aligned with client business objectives and organizational goals is central to this role. You will establish project governance frameworks, control mechanisms, and quality standards while ensuring seamless integration of design, execution, and handover phases. Making critical decisions on project direction, resource allocation, and risk mitigation strategies will be fundamental responsibilities.
   

  

**Client Relationship Management**
 Serving as the senior relationship owner for key accounts, you will build and maintain C\-suite level relationships with corporate clients including multinational corporations, technology companies, financial institutions, and large domestic enterprises. Understanding client business drivers, workplace strategies, and organizational culture to deliver tailored solutions is essential. You will lead client presentations, strategic planning sessions, and executive steering committee meetings. Identifying opportunities for account expansion, repeat business, and referrals while ensuring exceptional client satisfaction and loyalty will drive business growth.
   

  

**Program \& Portfolio Management**
 Managing corporate interior programs involving multiple locations, phased implementations, or integrated workplace transformations is expected. You will develop master program schedules, resource plans, and integrated budgets across project portfolios. Coordinating dependencies between concurrent projects and optimizing resource utilization across the team will be critical. Establishing standardization frameworks for clients with multi\-city requirements while maintaining consistency in quality and delivery approach is necessary.
   

  

**Financial \& Commercial Excellence**
 You will be accountable for P\&L management of assigned projects, ensuring profitability targets are achieved. Preparing detailed cost estimates, budgets, and financial forecasts for complex interior fitouts is required. Negotiating commercial terms with contractors, vendors, and consultants to optimize project economics while maintaining quality standards is essential. Managing contract administration including variations, claims, and commercial settlements is fundamental. Conducting value engineering exercises and identifying cost optimization opportunities without compromising design intent or quality will support project success.
   

  

**Design Coordination \& Technical Excellence**
 Collaborating with architects, interior designers, and consultants to translate design concepts into executable construction documentation is necessary. Ensuring design compliance with building codes, safety regulations, accessibility standards, and sustainability requirements is mandatory. Coordinating MEP systems integration, IT infrastructure, security systems, and audiovisual technology within interior spaces requires technical oversight. Reviewing and approving material selections, finishes, furniture systems, and specialty installations while balancing aesthetics, functionality, durability, and budget constraints is expected.
   

  

**Quality Assurance \& Delivery**
 Establishing and enforcing rigorous quality standards across all project phases from design review through final handover is paramount. Conducting design reviews, site inspections, material approvals, and installation quality audits systematically is required. Managing testing and commissioning of MEP systems, IT infrastructure, and integrated building systems is necessary. Overseeing punch list management, defect rectification, and warranty administration to ensure flawless client handovers is essential.
   

  

**Team Leadership \& Development**
 Leading, mentoring, and developing a team of Project Managers, Assistant Project Managers, and Coordinators is a core responsibility. Providing technical guidance, coaching on client management, and supporting professional growth of team members will build organizational capability. Conducting performance reviews, setting development goals, and creating succession plans for critical roles is expected. Fostering a collaborative, high\-performance culture focused on excellence, innovation, and client success is fundamental.
   

  

**Risk \& Issue Management**
 Proactively identifying project risks related to design, construction, schedule, budget, or stakeholder management is critical. Developing comprehensive risk mitigation plans and contingency strategies with quantified impact assessments is required. Managing critical issues through rapid problem\-solving, stakeholder coordination, and effective decision\-making is necessary. Escalating major risks or issues to senior management with recommended action plans when appropriate ensures proper governance.
   

  

**Business Development Support**
 Supporting proposal development and client pitches for new corporate interior opportunities across Gujarat is expected. Providing technical inputs, methodology frameworks, and project approach strategies for competitive bids will contribute to win rates. Participating in client meetings, site visits, and presentations during business development cycles demonstrates thought leadership. Representing JLL at industry forums, client events, and networking opportunities to build brand visibility and market presence supports business growth.
   

  

**Innovation \& Best Practices**
 Staying current with emerging trends in workplace design, flexible workspaces, activity\-based working, and workplace technology is essential. Introducing innovative project delivery methods, digital tools, and process improvements to enhance efficiency and client value is valued. Sharing knowledge, lessons learned, and best practices across the PDS team to drive continuous improvement demonstrates leadership. Contributing to development of standard operating procedures, project templates, and knowledge management systems builds organizational capability.
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
**Education \& Experience**
 Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, Interior Design, or Construction Management is required; Master's degree in Project Management, Construction Management, or MBA is preferred. A minimum of 12\-16 years of progressive experience in project management with at least 8 years focused on corporate interiors, commercial fitouts, or office projects is essential. Demonstrated track record of successfully delivering 20\+ corporate interior projects with values ranging from ₹5 crores to ₹50\+ crores is mandatory. Minimum 4\-5 years in leadership roles managing project teams and multiple concurrent projects is required. Experience working with Fortune 500 companies, multinational corporations, or large Indian conglomerates is highly valued.
   

  

**Technical Competencies**
 Comprehensive knowledge of interior construction systems, materials, finishes, furniture systems, and specialty installations is required. Expert understanding of MEP systems coordination, raised flooring, modular partitions, suspended ceilings, and integrated technology solutions is necessary. Thorough knowledge of NBC, state building regulations, fire safety codes, accessibility standards, and sustainability frameworks (LEED, IGBC, WELL) is mandatory. Proficiency in project management software including Primavera P6 or MS Project for scheduling, along with advanced skills in MS Office Suite for reporting and presentations is expected. Familiarity with AutoCAD or Revit for reviewing drawings and BIM coordination is advantageous.
   

  

**Commercial \& Financial Skills**
 Strong commercial acumen with proven ability to manage project budgets ranging from ₹5 crores to ₹50\+ crores successfully is essential. Experience in contract negotiation, procurement strategy, and vendor management is required. Understanding of construction contracts including FIDIC, JCT, or standard Indian contract formats is necessary. Ability to conduct value engineering, cost\-benefit analysis, and financial scenario modeling is valued. Experience with budget forecasting, cash flow management, and financial reporting to clients and management is expected.
   

  

**Leadership \& Management Capabilities**
 Proven leadership experience managing teams of 5\-15 professionals across multiple projects simultaneously is required. Strong mentoring and coaching abilities with track record of developing high\-performing teams is essential. Strategic thinking capability with ability to balance operational excellence with business development objectives is necessary. Executive presence and ability to engage confidently with C\-suite stakeholders and senior client representatives is fundamental. Change management skills to drive adoption of new processes, tools, or methodologies across teams is valued.
   

  

**Communication \& Interpersonal Skills**
 Exceptional communication and presentation skills in English and Hindi (Gujarati is highly advantageous) with ability to articulate complex technical concepts to non\-technical audiences is required. Strong negotiation and conflict resolution capabilities to manage contractor disputes, client concerns, and stakeholder disagreements is essential. Relationship\-building skills with ability to establish trust and credibility with diverse stakeholders including clients, consultants, contractors, and internal teams is necessary. Diplomatic approach to managing sensitive issues while maintaining professional relationships and project momentum is valued.
   

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
 PMP (Project Management Professional) certification from PMI demonstrates project management excellence. LEED AP or IGBC AP certification indicates sustainability expertise relevant to corporate interiors. Experience with design\-build, EPC, or integrated project delivery methods is valuable. Exposure to workplace strategy consulting, change management, or organizational development enhances strategic value. Knowledge of Agile project management or Lean Construction principles demonstrates innovation mindset. Prior experience with JLL or international project management consultancies provides cultural alignment.
   

  

**Key Performance Indicators**
 Project delivery success measured by on\-time, on\-budget completion with quality standards met across portfolio. Client satisfaction scores averaging 4\.5\+/5\.0 with strong Net Promoter Scores and testimonials. Financial performance including revenue targets, profit margins, and collection efficiency metrics. Business development contribution through successful conversions, account expansion, and referral generation. Team development measured by retention rates, skill progression, and promotion readiness of direct reports. Risk management effectiveness demonstrated by minimal claims, disputes, or quality issues across projects.
   

  

**Work Environment \& Expectations**
 This role is based in Gujarat (Ahmedabad/Gandhinagar) with regular travel across Gujarat and occasional travel to other Indian cities as project demands require. Hybrid work arrangement with significant time spent at project sites for inspections, meetings, and stakeholder coordination. Client\-facing role requiring flexibility to attend meetings, site visits, and presentations according to client schedules. Extended working hours during critical project phases, milestone deadlines, or client emergencies may be necessary. Professional office environment when not on site, with collaborative workspace and access to modern technology tools.
   

  

**What We Offer**
**Career Growth \& Development**
 Opportunity to lead prestigious corporate interior projects for India's leading corporations and multinationals with high visibility and impact. Clear career progression path to Associate Director, Director, and senior leadership roles within JLL PDS practice. Access to JLL's global learning platform with technical training, leadership development programs, and professional certifications. Exposure to international best practices through JLL's global network and knowledge\-sharing platforms. Mentorship from senior JLL leadership and opportunity to shape the future of PDS practice in Gujarat.
   

  

**Compensation \& Benefits**
 Highly competitive compensation package commensurate with experience, including performance\-based incentives tied to project success and business development. Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, life insurance, and wellness programs. Professional development allowance for certifications, training, and industry conferences. Flexible benefits options to suit individual needs and preferences.
   

  

**Work Culture**
 Collaborative, inclusive work environment that values diversity, innovation, and professional excellence. Opportunity to work with talented professionals committed to delivering exceptional client outcomes. Recognition programs celebrating project successes, innovation, and exemplary performance. Work\-life integration support with flexible arrangements where operationally feasible. Commitment to sustainability, corporate social responsibility, and ethical business practices across all operations.
   

  

**Location**
 Gujarat (Ahmedabad/Gandhinagar preferred) Regular travel across Gujarat required; occasional travel to other locations
   

  

**JLL is an Equal Opportunity Employer**
 We are committed to creating an inclusive work environment that reflects the diversity of our clients and communities. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of gender, race, religion, age, disability, or other protected characteristics.
   

  

**To Apply**
 Please submit your resume, portfolio of completed projects (with project values, scope, and outcomes), and cover letter through JLL's career portal or contact your local HR representative in Gujarat for application procedures.
   

  

 Shortlisted candidates will be required to present case studies of successfully delivered projects and participate in competency\-based interviews with JLL leadership.
   

  

**Application Deadline:** 
 Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis until the position is filled.
   

  

*JLL is committed to developing and retaining top talent. This role offers exceptional growth potential for the right candidate who demonstrates technical excellence, leadership capability, and commitment to client success.*

title: Scheduler
description:

title: Fabrication Engineer
description:
Fabrication Engineer
 
  





**Location:** 
 Ahmedabad, Gujarat
 



**Department:** 
 Fabrication / Production
 



**Experience:** 
 5–8 Years
 



**Industry Preference:** 
 Heavy Engineering / Industrial Machinery / Construction Equipment / Structural Fabrication
 



  




 About the Company
 
**Macons** 
 is an established Indian manufacturer of construction and infrastructure equipment, with a strong focus on
 **concrete batching plants, concrete mixers, concrete block making machines, concrete pumps, and other specialized construction machinery** 
 .
 



 With decades of experience in the industry, Macons is committed to delivering
 **reliable, robust, and technologically advanced equipment** 
 that helps contractors and infrastructure companies improve productivity and efficiency.
 



 At Macons, we believe in
 **engineering excellence, continuous improvement, and building long\-term relationships with our customers** 
 .
 



  




 About the Role
 
 We are looking for an experienced
 **Fabrication Engineer** 
 to join our manufacturing team in Ahmedabad. The candidate will be responsible for managing and supervising day\-to\-day fabrication activities for heavy machinery components, ensuring that production is completed safely, efficiently, and as per approved drawings and quality standards.
 



 The ideal candidate should have strong
 **hands\-on shop\-floor experience in MS fabrication, welding, fit\-up, cutting, drilling, bending, and dimensional inspection** 
 , along with the ability to manage manpower and achieve production targets.
 



  




 Key Responsibilities
 * Plan, supervise, and monitor daily fabrication activities on the shop floor.
* Manage fabrication of machine structures, frames, hoppers, platforms, brackets, tanks, and other fabricated components.
* Read and interpret
 **fabrication drawings, assembly drawings, BOMs, and welding details** 
 .
* Plan fabrication sequences to improve productivity and minimize rework.
* Supervise
 **cutting, bending, fit\-up, welding, grinding, drilling, and finishing** 
 operations.
* Coordinate with welders, fitters, fabricators, helpers, and other shop\-floor personnel.
* Allocate manpower and machines according to production priorities.
* Monitor daily production against planned targets and take corrective action when required.
* Ensure fabricated components meet required
 **dimensions, tolerances, alignment, and welding quality** 
 .
* Identify fabrication defects such as distortion, weld defects, dimensional mismatch, improper fit\-up, and excessive rework.
* Coordinate with the
 **Design, Production, Quality, Stores, and Assembly departments** 
 for smooth workflow.
* Ensure availability of required raw materials, consumables, drawings, tools, and fixtures before starting fabrication.
* Monitor material utilization and minimize wastage.
* Implement proper fabrication sequences and welding procedures to control distortion.
* Conduct in\-process inspections and coordinate with the Quality team for final inspection.
* Maintain fabrication\-related production records and daily progress reports.
* Identify bottlenecks in fabrication and implement practical solutions to improve productivity.
* Ensure adherence to workplace safety procedures and proper use of PPE.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives related to
 **productivity, quality, cost, and delivery** 
 .



  




 Required Skills \& Qualifications
 * Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in
 **Mechanical Engineering** 
 or related discipline.
* **5–8 years of relevant experience in fabrication** 
 , preferably in heavy engineering or machinery manufacturing.
* Strong practical knowledge of
 **MS fabrication and welding processes** 
 .
* Good understanding of
 **MIG/MAG, ARC welding and gas cutting** 
 .
* Ability to read and understand mechanical and fabrication drawings.
* Knowledge of fabrication tolerances, fit\-up, alignment, welding sequence, and distortion control.
* Experience in handling and supervising shop\-floor manpower.
* Good knowledge of fabrication tools, machinery, fixtures, and measuring instruments.
* Ability to identify fabrication and welding defects.
* Strong problem\-solving and production\-planning skills.
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Proficiency in
 **MS Excel and basic production reporting** 
 .



  




 Preferred Experience
 
 Candidates with experience in any of the following industries will be preferred:
 


* Heavy Machinery Manufacturing
* Construction Equipment
* Concrete Machinery
* Crane Manufacturing
* Material Handling Equipment
* Industrial Equipment
* Structural Steel Fabrication
* Heavy Engineering
* EPC / Industrial Fabrication



  




 What We Are Looking For
 
 We are looking for someone who is
 **strong on the shop floor** 
 , understands fabrication practically, and can independently manage fabrication activities from
 **raw material to ready\-for\-assembly components** 
 .
 



 Candidates whose experience is primarily limited to CAD/design work and who do not have hands\-on fabrication or shop\-floor supervision experience may not be suitable for this position.
 



  




 Why Join Us?
 * Opportunity to work on
 **large industrial machinery and heavy engineering projects**
* **Hands\-on exposure to complete machinery manufacturing**
* **Opportunity to work closely with Design, Production, Quality, and Assembly teams**
* **Growth opportunity within the manufacturing organization**
* **Job Type:** 
 Full\-time
* **Location:** 
 Ahmedabad, Gujarat

About the job
 
  





 Job Title: Operations Executive
 



 Location: Ahmedabad, Gujarat
 



 Experience: 0–1 Years
 



 Eligibility: Freshers with strong aptitude and communication skills can also apply
 



  





 About KiarX
 



  





 KiarX is a revolutionary and unique mining management platform that integrates all mining business components into a single app and website. The platform provides live production status, trip report analysis, driver performance monitoring, machinery maintenance tracking, diesel reports, and other critical mining business insights, all accessible through the KiarX app and web dashboard.
 



  





 Role Description
 



  





 We are looking for a proactive and detail\-oriented Operations Executive to join our team in Ahmedabad. The role involves coordinating between field teams, clients, and internal departments to ensure the smooth implementation and functioning of the KiarX system at mining sites.The Operations Captain will monitor operational activities, analyze mining data, coordinate with field executives, support client communication, and ensure effective adoption of KiarX solutions at the ground level. The role may also involve travel to mining project sites as required.
 



  





 Responsibilities
 



  




* Coordinate and support the management and troubleshooting of KiarX hardware and systems through internal teams and field executives.
* Coordinate with mining sites and field teams to ensure smooth day\-to\-day operations.
* Conduct site visits when required for operational monitoring, coordination, and client interaction.
* Collect feedback from site teams, drivers, operators, and client representatives.
* Monitor mining operations remotely using KiarX digital dashboards and tools.
* Track system performance and coordinate with technical teams to ensure maximum uptime and smooth functioning.
* Review and analyze trip data, diesel consumption reports, driver performance, and other operational metrics.
* Prepare and maintain daily and weekly operational reports.
* Identify operational issues and coordinate with relevant teams for timely resolution.
* Act as a coordination point between field executives, clients, and internal departments.
* Support client onboarding and implementation of KiarX solutions at mining sites.
* Assist in preparing training materials, guides, SOPs, and operational documentation.
* Maintain records, compliance documentation, and operational reports.
* Ensure operational processes are followed as per company protocols and safety standards.
* Follow up with field teams on assigned tasks and ensure timely completion.
* Provide regular updates to the management regarding operational performance, issues, and site requirements.



  





 Qualifications
 


* Bachelor’s degree in Operations/PGDM; MBA is mandatory.
* 0–1 years of experience; freshers with strong aptitude may also apply.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
* Good analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Ability to understand and analyze operational data and reports.
* Good proficiency in English communication.
* Basic knowledge of MS Excel and digital reporting tools is preferred.
* Ability to coordinate effectively with multiple teams.
* Willingness to travel to mining project sites when required.
* Prior exposure to mining operations or industrial operations will be an added advantage.
* Ability to work in a team\-oriented, technology\-driven, and field\-connected environment.



  





 What we are looking for
 



  





 We are looking for candidates who are responsible, proactive, disciplined, and willing to take ownership of operational tasks. The ideal candidate should be comfortable coordinating with different teams, analyzing operational information, following up on tasks, and communicating effectively with both internal teams and clients.
 



  





 How to apply
 


* Interested candidates can share their updated resume at:📧 hr@kiarx.com with Subject: Application for Operations Executive – Ahmedabad
